Look at the time already. It's a shame I didn't get to enjoy the Ash Wave properly.
You enjoyed it so much that Embla begged you to stop and leave.
It was valuable time spent strengthening friendly ties with Nidaros as a representative of the Empire.
Father Askren said he'd see us off, but thanks to you, he's too hungover to get up.
strings.겨우 그 정도 가지고…? 흐음… 사제님 이야기는 그만하고, 천사님께 간다: From that little...? Hmm... Enough about the priest. Did you tell the angel you're leaving?
I quietly went to say goodbye at dawn.
strings.아, 미리 말할 걸 그랬나? 천사님에게 여쭤보고 싶은 게 하나 있었는데…: Oh, I should have mentioned it earlier. There was something I wanted to ask her...
strings.마을 사람들이 '눈매가 날카로운 귀족 청년'을 본 것 같다고 했잖아. 그: The villagers said they'd seen a young nobleman with sharp eyes. He wasn't Lord Muller, the man I'm looking for.
strings.어, 그럼 누구지…? 아니, 그보다 뮐러 경에게 무슨 일 있어요?: Oh, then who was it...? Wait, has something happened to Lord Muller?
strings.정확히는 몰라. 다만 행방이 묘연해져서 임무 수행차 나가는 곳마다 알아보: I don't know exactly. But his whereabouts are unknown, so I've been asking wherever my missions take me.
strings.여기서도 알아낸 게 없어. 혹시 천사님은 알고 계신가 해서 여쭤보려 했지: I didn't learn anything here, either. I wanted to ask whether the angel knew anything.
strings.제가 알아볼게요. 잠깐 기다리세요. 어, 레나 씨?: I'll find out. Wait a moment. Oh, Lena?
strings.마음만 받을게. 안 그래도 할 일이 많을 텐데 이런 일까지 맡기고 싶진: I appreciate the thought. You already have so much to do. I don't want to burden you with this, too.
Don't worry. It'll be all right.
If you say so, Lena... All right.
Thank you for understanding. Oh, I almost forgot.
strings.일이 끝났다고 황성에 서신을 보냈어. 글래스턴에 도착하면 폐하를 알현해야: I sent a letter to the palace saying our work is finished. We'll need to see Her Majesty when we reach Glaston.
I was planning to tell her in person anyway.
Good. Then let's return to Glaston.
Wow, %s! Lady Lena! It's been a while.
strings.글래스턴에는 별일 없었지?: Nothing happened in Glaston, I hope?
strings.조금 분주하긴 했지만 큰일은 없었어여. 두 분은 임무 잘 마치신 거예여?: It's been a little busy, but nothing major. Did your mission go well?
Thanks to everyone's help, we finished safely.
strings.다행이네여. 어떤 일인지 많이 궁금하긴 하지만! 묻지 않을게여. 비밀 임: I'm glad. I'm really curious about what happened, but I won't ask! Secret missions only shine when their secrets are kept.
Hehe. I like you too, Lady Lena.
I'll invite you to my home sometime.
strings.레나 씨, 언제 폐하를 알현하러 가실 건가요?: Lena, when are we going to see Her Majesty?
Could you wait here a moment? It won't take long. I'll stop by the government offices.
strings.%s 님, 저 오늘 일 다 끝났어여. 레나 경 오실 동안 같이 수다 떨면: %s, I'm done with work today. Want to chat while we wait for Lady Lena?
strings.글래스턴이 원래대로 돌아오고 나서 관청들이 바빠졌어여. 기분 나쁜 마법사: Ever since Glaston returned to normal, the offices have been busy. The Magic Bureau with those creepy mages certainly deserved to be closed.
strings.의회에서 아론 의장 편을 들던 귀족들 있잖아여. 전에 그 사람들, 의장: You know those nobles who sided with Chairman Aaron in the assembly? They used to obey his every word like Prirings rolling over and showing their bellies.
strings.그런데 아론이라는 사람이 없던 게 되니까, 의장 자리가 공석이 된 지 오: But now that Aaron apparently never existed, they're saying the chairmanship has been vacant for ages and deciding who should take it.
strings.재미있는 건 말이져, 서로 다른 사람 보고 하라는 거예여. 소문에 의하면: The funny thing is, they all keep telling each other to do it. Rumor has it the imperial family uncovered lots of noble corruption. Maybe that's why.
Hmm. So that's what's been happening.
strings.글래스턴 일은 아니지만, 최근 황성에서 마법 관련 기관을 다시 정비하기로: This isn't just about Glaston, but the palace recently decided to reorganize the institutions dealing with magic.
strings.마법학원하고 현자의 탑 말인가요?: You mean the magic academy and the Tower of Sages?
strings.맞아여. 마법청 개편하면서 현자의 탑은 임시 폐쇄, 마법학원 제레니스는: That's right. As part of the Magic Bureau reforms, the Tower of Sages was temporarily closed, and Xerenis Magic Academy was ordered to suspend classes.
strings.그래도 마법학원 제레니스는 명령이 해제돼서 방학을 보낸 느낌이었을 텐데,: The academy's order has already been lifted, so it probably felt like a vacation. But the Tower of Sages is taking longer than expected.
I don't know all the details.
You know quite a lot for someone who doesn't know the details.
I heard things while patrolling the administrative district, and Silvia told me some of it herself.
strings.흐음…. 글래스턴도 이제 괜찮은 걸까요?: Hmm... Is Glaston going to be all right now?
It has to be. If it isn't, I'll do something about it.
strings.그러니까 %s 님도 힘내세여. 여태 잘해 오셨으니까 앞으로도 다 잘하실: So keep your chin up too, %s. You've done great so far. You'll do great in the future, too.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Time to go.
Letty, we'd better go. See you later.
strings.(카이나가 환하게 웃으며 두 사람을 맞이한다.): (Kaina welcomes them with a bright smile.)
I'm glad you both returned safely.
We intended to visit you at the palace. I didn't expect you to be here.
strings.두 분이 곧 오실 것 같아서 아르젠트의 만류에도 불구하고 먼저 나왔답니다: I thought you would arrive soon, so I came out despite Argent's objections.
Your Majesty, coming from the palace to the square or administrative district is fine...
But going all the way to the Void Sea without telling anyone is dangerous.
strings.어머, 아르젠트. 그건 어떻게 알았어요?: Oh, Argent. How did you know?
strings.정체를 숨기고 움직이셨겠지만, 그래도 흔적이 너무 많이 남아 모른 척할: You may have concealed your identity, but you left too many traces for me to ignore.
I'm sorry. There was somewhere I simply had to go.
I will hear about that later.
strings.(카이나가 레나와 모험가를 향해 시선을 돌린다.): (Kaina turns toward Lena and the adventurer.)
strings.그럼 니다로스에서 있었던 일을 말씀해 주시겠어요?: Now, will you tell me what happened in Nidaros?
strings.(카이나에게 니다로스에서 있었던 일을 보고한다.): (I report the events in Nidaros to Kaina.)
strings.고대의 유적 '날개'를 깨워 다른 고대의 유적과 부딪혀 세계를 파괴하려: Awakening the ancient Wings to crash them into another ancient ruin and destroy the world...
In any case, thank you both for your efforts...
I did very little compared with %s.
Not at all. Lady Lena was a great help.
It's hard to understand Daphne's actions, but she must have her reasons.
strings.자신의 아이를 지키기 위해서 아론을 처단하고 나아가 신마저 죽이겠다는 건: She disposed of Aaron to protect her child, and now intends to kill even a god...
She doesn't seem to pose an immediate threat to the Empire, but we must consider how to respond.
Lena, you've worked hard. You've had so much to do that you can hardly have rested... Take a few days off, then go look for Lord Muller.
I will speak with your superior.
strings.제 능력이 좀 더 뛰어났더라면 그의 행방을 알 수 있었을 텐데…. 알아낸: If only my ability were stronger, I might have found him... I'm sorry I learned nothing.
strings.(폐하도 알고 계셨구나. 하긴 모르는 게 더 이상하겠지.): (Her Majesty knew, too. I suppose it would be stranger if she didn't.)
Lena, I will contact you separately if I need your help.
strings.저, 폐하…. 혹시 최근에 다른 예지를 보신 게 있으십니까?: Your Majesty... Have you had any other visions recently?
I have, but only trivial ones.
strings.광장을 관리하는 청년이 연인에게 꽃을 선물한다거나, 실비아가 파픈스타 데: The young man who tends the square giving flowers to his sweetheart, or Silvia going to a performance by Pop'n Star Daisy...
strings.나중에라도 중요한 걸 보게 되거나 놓친 게 있다면 전해 드릴게요. 그러면: If I see anything important, or realize I missed something, I'll let you know. What will you do now?
strings.저, 다시 한번 %s에게 감사드리고 싶어요. 그동안 제국이 해내지 못한: I want to thank you once again, %s. You resolved what the Empire had been unable to.
strings.저는 이제 마법청을 정리하고, 제국에서 마법이 의미하는 바를 다시 세우려: I now intend to set the Magic Bureau in order and redefine what magic means within the Empire.
It will take a long time to wash away the sins those fools committed...
But that is the atonement the Empire can offer the continent of Freios...
strings.그리고 다른 이들과 함께 살아가기 위해서 반드시 필요한 걸음이라고 생각해: And a necessary step toward living together with others.
strings.벌써 시간이 이렇게 됐군요. 이제 의회의 귀족들과 회의를 해야 해서 이만: Is it that late already? I must meet with the nobles of the assembly, so I will take my leave.
Yes, Your Majesty. Until next time.
Take care on your way back, both of you. Your Majesty, shall we?
strings.(레나와 모험가가 고개 숙여 카이나를 배웅한다.): (Lena and the adventurer bow as Kaina leaves.)
Her Majesty and the Empire will have increasingly busy days ahead...
strings.이제 여신님 만나러 갈 거지?: You're going to see the goddess now?
Her Majesty ordered it, so I'll go home and rest.
See you later, then. Get some good rest.
strings.(에이도스 관문. 신탁의 방이 가까워지자 모험가의 발걸음이 저절로 멈춘다: (Eidos Gateway. As the Oracle Chamber draws near, the adventurer's feet stop of their own accord.)
strings.(주위를 둘러보지만, 이리스를 만나러 올 때면 항상 봐 왔던 에이도스의: (I look around, but see only the familiar scenery of Eidos from my visits to Iris.)
Am I imagining things? Whew... All right, let's go in.
strings.(모험가가 신탁의 방을 향해 발을 내딛는 순간, 먼발치에서 그를 바라보고: (As the adventurer steps toward the Oracle Chamber, someone watching from a distance slowly reveals herself.)
strings.여신의 모험가라 그런가, 역시 감이 좋네. 후후, 바르바토스와의 만남,: Such keen instincts. As expected of the goddess's adventurer. Hehe. Enjoy your meeting with Barbatos.
strings.(뭐, 뭐지? 항상 보던 신탁의 방인데 왜 이렇게 불길한 기운이….): (Wh-what? It's the Oracle Chamber I always visit, but why does it feel so ominous...?)
strings.(시야를 가린 장막이 걷히자, 언제나처럼 미소 짓는 이리스가 아니라 모험: (The veil blocking my view lifts. In place of Iris's usual smile stands the figure who always greets the adventurer with a sneer.)
strings.바르바토스? 잠깐, 이리스… 이리스는 어디 있어?!: Barbatos? Wait, Iris... Where is Iris?!
strings.이리스를 어떻게 했어?!: What have you done to Iris?!
As I thought, you have no intention of listening. The goddess is where she belongs.
Such little faith in a god...
strings.(순간 바르바토스의 기척이 사라지고, 이어진 일격이 %s의 몸을 허공으로: (Barbatos's presence vanishes for an instant. His next blow sends %s flying.)
strings.(히, 힘이 들어가지 않아…. 버, 버텨야 해….): (I-I have no strength... I have to hold on...)
(Barbatos raises his gunblade and throws it straight into %s's abdomen.)
strings.(바르바토스가 바닥에 쓰러진 모험가를 무심히 내려다본다.): (Barbatos looks down indifferently at the fallen adventurer.)
strings.…아직 발악할 힘이 남았습니까? 처음부터 제 이야기에 귀를 기울였다면 이: ...Still have the strength to struggle? You could have avoided this pain if you'd listened from the start...
strings.여기서 죽일 생각은 없습니다. 애초에 당신이 쉽게 죽을 위인도 아니고…: I don't intend to kill you here. You were never someone who dies easily, anyway... And ending it like this isn't my style.
strings.이 영역은 신탁의 방을 본뜬 가짜라 여신에게 아무런 위해도 되지 않는다고: I was going to tell you this is a false realm modeled after the Oracle Chamber, posing no danger to the goddess...
strings.모두 당신의 성급함이 자초한 결과입니다. 자, 그 상태로 제 이야기를 들: All of this is the result of your impatience. Now, listen as you are.
strings.쿨럭, 쿨럭. 대체 무슨 이야기를 하려는 거지?: Cough, cough. What do you want to talk about?
strings.다프네를 어떻게 처리할 생각입니까?: How do you intend to deal with Daphne?
As expected, you have no answer.
strings.당신도 알 테죠. 생명이, 또는 신의 힘에 영향을 받은 존재조차 신을 멸: You know that living beings, even those influenced by divine power, are almost entirely incapable of destroying a god.
strings.전령이던 엘-라르사가 소멸한 모습을 직접 보지 않았습니까? 그게 세계의: You saw the messenger Ell-Larsa perish yourself, didn't you? That is the law of this world.
strings.하지만… 그게 가능하다면 어떻게 하시겠습니까? 세계의 이치에 맞지 않는: But... what if it were possible? If someone knew a way that defied the world's laws, and could wield it...
strings.그동안 다프네는 '자신의 아이'를 위한다면서 많은 마녀를 죽이고 힘을 축: Daphne has killed many witches and accumulated their power, all for the sake of 'her child.'
For someone who was already a monster to openly declare that she will kill a god...
strings.헤카테 여신은 결코 만만한 상대가 아니지만, 이미 그의 힘은 여신을 넘어: The goddess Hecate is no easy opponent, but Daphne's power may already surpass hers.
strings.%s. 신을 죽인 자가 어떻게 될 것 같습니까? 결코 하나로는 끝나지 않: %s. What do you think happens to someone who kills a god? It never ends with just one.
They become consumed by an inexplicable obsession, seeking out and killing the few gods that remain.
strings.과거에도 그런 자가 있었습니다. 악신을 죽이고 '디어사이드'가 돼서 목표: There was someone like that in the past. They killed an evil god, became a Deicide, and achieved their goal, yet did not stop.
strings.묻겠습니다. 다프네가 이리스 여신을 살려 둘 것 같습니까?: Tell me. Do you think Daphne will spare the goddess Iris?
strings.그래서 제안을 하나 드리려 합니다. 이리스 여신의 최후를 두 눈으로 보고: That is why I have a proposal. If you do not wish to witness Iris's end...
strings.또는 반대로 이리스 여신에게 당신의 죽음을 보이고 싶지 않다면, 제 것이: Or, conversely, if you do not wish her to witness your death, become mine.
I promise you. I will show you a better path.
strings.말 같지도 않은 제안, 선심 쓰듯이 내뱉지 마. 자격 없는 마족이 주제넘: Don't offer that nonsense as though you're doing me a favor. An unworthy demon, overstepping... You could never be a god... Cough, cough.
Very well. Your wishes are clear... Not that I expected anything from the start...
strings.어차피 멸망할 운명인 세계. 조금이라도 가능성이 있는 쪽을 선택하라는 것: This world is doomed to perish. I merely offered you a choice with some chance of success. What a pity.
strings.곧 자리를 마련하겠습니다. 당신과 여신이 서로의 최후를 바라보게 될 무대: I will prepare a stage soon. A stage where you and your goddess will witness each other's end...
(Barbatos smiles faintly, raises his gunblade, and aims at the adventurer's head.)
Now I shall send you to your goddess.
(With those words, the cold blade descends, and the adventurer's vision shatters into white.)
strings.(그리고 어디선가 거울이 깨지는 소리가 들려온다.): (Then, somewhere, comes the sound of breaking glass.)
strings.이리스, 이리스…. 괜찮아?: Iris, Iris... Are you all right?
Hah... Hah... Huh? Just a moment ago, Barbatos was...
That strange presence I sensed outside the Oracle Chamber... Could it have been...?
strings.(이리스에게 바르바토스와 마주쳤던 일을 이야기한다.): (I tell Iris about my encounter with Barbatos.)
strings.(이리스가 두 손을 모아 눈을 감고 기도한다. 그러자 하늘에서 작은 빛들: (Iris clasps her hands, closes her eyes, and prays. Tiny lights drift down from above and fill the space.)
I've purified all of Eidos. It should be safe now.
strings.바르바토스가 '가짜'라고 하긴 했지만 신탁의 방 모습이라서 기분이… 섬뜩: Barbatos said it was a fake, but seeing the Oracle Chamber like that... It was chilling.
strings.이 공간을 알고 있다면 신이었다는 말이 거짓은 아닐 거예요. 똑같이 만들: If he knows this place, his claim to have been a god may be true. He made an identical space and waited there...
strings.하지만 혼자서는 불가능했을 거예요. 없는 공간을 완벽히 제어하는 일은 신: But he couldn't have done it alone. Perfectly controlling a space that doesn't exist is difficult even for a god.
strings.내가 그렇게 공격을 받고도 상처 입지 않고 살아 있는 건 바르바토스 옆에: Maybe the reason I'm alive and unhurt after all those attacks is the power of someone helping Barbatos.
strings.맞아요. 니다로스에서 %s의 목소리가 제게 들리지 않았던 걸 보면 그 영: Yes. That may also be why I couldn't hear your voice in Nidaros, %s.
There's something I need to tell you.
strings.위대한 벽의 틈 사이에서 가끔 어떤 '흐름'이 보여요. 전 그걸 에트와르: Sometimes I see a kind of current through the gaps in the great wall. I call it the presence of destruction approaching Etoile...
It is a mixture of many forms of malice, and sometimes it takes the shape of particular people...
I saw them closer than anyone else. Daphne and Barbatos...
Even now, two more witches have lost their lives and powers to Daphne.
strings.그리고 바르바토스는 일부러 그러는 것처럼 자신의 행선지를 드러내고 있어요: And Barbatos is revealing his movements as though deliberately...
Nidaros, Knossos, and even the place where the Tower of Sages stands.
strings.니다로스에는 다프네 때문에 온 것 같다고 해도 크노소스와 현자의 탑에는: He may have gone to Nidaros because of Daphne, but why Knossos and the Tower of Sages?
strings.쉬지 않고 가도 괜찮겠어요?: Will you be all right going without a rest?
I'm fine. No problem at all.
strings.알겠어요. 저도 곧 위대한 벽의 정리를 일부 마칠 수 있을 거예요. 그때: All right. I'll soon finish putting part of the great wall in order. Hold on until then. I'm sorry. I'll join you as soon as I can.
And don't worry too much if you can't hear my voice.
strings.그럼 크노소스로 가서 확인해 볼게. 탈로스라면 '디어사이드'에 대해 뭔가: I'll go to Knossos and find out. Talos might know something about Deicide.
Iris, I'll be back. See you later.
strings.조만간 볼 줄은 알았는데, 이렇게 보게 되는군. 내가 그렇게 구박했는데도: I knew we'd meet soon, but I didn't expect this. Despite all my scolding, you came and cleaned so diligently.
It's nice and clean now. In return, I'll tell you what you want to know.
So you already know what that is.
strings.얌전히 여기 앉아서 들어. 혹시 간식 필요해?: Sit quietly here and listen. Want a snack?
No, thank you. Please go on.
As you've probably guessed, I'm not actually Talos.
Sigh. All that traveling has made you better at winding people up.
strings.좋아. 이렇게 이야기할 건데, 어느 것부터 들을래?: All right. Here's what I can tell you. What would you like to hear first?
During the Sky of Chaos, countless factions fought for supremacy across the continent.
Until then, we had no interest in what beings outside Creed did. We simply thought we should stay out of one another's affairs.
strings.그런 태도가 점점 우리를 고립시켰다는 사실도 모른 채, 인간들의 습격을: Unaware that this attitude was gradually isolating us, we came under attack from humans.
strings.그들은 더럽고 탐욕스럽고 잔인한 수인에게서 자신들을 지켜야 한다며 우리: They raided our forest, claiming they had to defend themselves from filthy, greedy, cruel beastkin.
strings.분명 그들은 원하는 게 있었고, 우리는 그게 뭔지 몰라 불안한 나날을 보: They clearly wanted something, and we spent our days in fear, not knowing what it was.
strings.그러던 어느 날, 실바리아의 어느 마법사가 찾아와 미노스 왕과의 대화를: Then one day, a mage from Silvaria arrived and requested an audience with King Minos.
strings.미노스 왕은 그에게서 정보를 얻어 내고 죽이려 했지만, 마법사가 마음에: King Minos intended to extract information from him and kill him, but apparently took a liking to him and changed his mind...
strings.그래, 제레니스. 서로 협력하기로 했는데… 모든 게 탈로스 때문에 꼬여: Yes, Xerenis. We agreed to cooperate... But Talos ruined everything.
strings.당시 탈로스와 나는 크리드의 숲을 지키는 신관 같은 존재였어. 신 없는: Talos and I were something like priests guarding Creed Forest. Empty titles in a world without gods, but we were still seeking a way to resist the human attacks.
We heard there was a being like a living god in the southwestern sea and went to see him. Glaucos. Meeting him did nothing to change Creed's plight, though.
strings.나는 무너지는 크리드의 운명을 받아들이려고 했지만, 탈로스는 달랐어. 금: I was ready to accept Creed's collapse, but Talos was different. He resorted to forbidden methods.
strings.연약한 생명 주제에 성계신이나 다룰 수 있는 위대한 벽의 틈을 찾았고,: A frail mortal, he found a gap in the great wall that only the God of the Astral Realm should command, and met our people's ancestral god, who had fled to another world.
strings.탈로스는 조상신에게 일족을 구해 달라고 빌었지만, 조상신은 우리 세계에: Talos begged the ancestral god to save our people, but he said he had no attachment to our world and would return to his own. He had already grown comfortable with another world's peace.
Enraged, Talos apparently stabbed him with a weapon he'd prepared. A god, destroyed by his own descendant...
You must find it absurd to hear. How could a god die like that...?
strings.약하고도 강하고, 강하면서도 약한 존재. 이 세계의 생명과 별반 다르지: Weak yet strong, strong yet weak. Not so different from this world's living beings. Well, afterward, Talos's mind collapsed as the price for killing a god.
strings.정신이 붕괴된 동생은 이렇게 된 게 모두 무능한 일족 때문이라며 원망하기: With his mind broken, my younger brother began blaming our people's incompetence for everything.
strings.처음에는 같은 일족을 저주하며 살해하더니, 산 채로 납치해 실바리아의 마: At first he cursed and murdered our own kin. Then he began kidnapping them alive and handing them over to Silvarian mages...
strings.그것도 모르고 난 동생과 함께 크리드를 구하겠다는 헛된 희망을 품고 있었: Not knowing any of this, I still clung to the futile hope that my brother and I would save Creed.
strings.그러던 중에 보고 말았어. 머릿속에 원초적인 악을 가득 채운 악마가 된: Then I saw it. My brother had become a demon, his mind filled with primal evil...
strings.미노스 왕과 파시파에를 비롯한 모두를 죽이겠다는 동생의 계획을 안 순간,: When I learned he planned to kill everyone, including King Minos and Pasiphae, I couldn't stand by.
strings.모두 안전한 공간에 봉인해 잠들게 하고, 우리를 살해하러 온 모든 인간: I sealed everyone in a safe space to sleep, then killed my brother and all the human mages who came to murder us...
strings.그렇게 끝난 줄 알았어. 다 끝났다고 믿었다고…. 하지만 다프네가 나타나: I thought it was over. I believed everything had ended... But Daphne appeared, and I learned it hadn't.
strings.먼 과거에 일족의 일부를 데리고 떠난 마녀가 갑자기 나타나서 뭐라고 했는: Do you know what that witch said when she suddenly returned, after leaving with some of our people in the distant past?
strings.내가 신을 죽인 탈로스를 죽이면서 육체가 그 힘을 이기지 못해 소멸했다는: That when I killed Talos, who had killed a god, my body couldn't withstand that power and was destroyed.
strings.믿을 수 없었지만 사실이었어. 내가 나라고 믿은 채로 다프네와 대화하고: I couldn't believe it, but it was true. The body speaking to Daphne, believing itself to be me, was Talos's.
My soul had entered Talos's body and was suppressing my brother's soul.
strings.그렇게 지금까지 탈로스로 살아왔다. 가끔 다프네한테 당하기도 하고, 너: And so I've lived as Talos ever since. Occasionally falling victim to Daphne, meeting people like you. It's been quite something...
strings.점점 동생의 영혼 크기가 작아져서 이젠 정말 사라졌나 했는데, 얼마 전에: My brother's soul kept shrinking until I thought it had finally vanished. Then Daphne put me to sleep recently and sent a letter saying she'd erased his soul.
strings.예전에는 영혼을 제어하지도 못했던 걸로 기억하는데…. 하아, 이젠 진짜: I remember she couldn't even control souls before... Sigh. Now my memories of my brother really are fading.
Well, that's enough. I have no feelings left toward him anyway.
strings.후우, 정말 잘된 걸까…? 시간이 흘렀어도 여전히 우리는 불안한 세계에: Whew. Was it really for the best...? Time has passed, but we're still in an unstable world.
Still... Things are getting better. It'll be all right.
strings.그렇게 믿고 싶은 거야? 아니면 진짜로 그렇게 믿는 거야?: Do you want to believe that, or do you really believe it?
I'd like to believe that, too, %s.
Hello, Lord Minos. How did you...?
strings.여신께서 크노소스에 묶인 헛된 시간의 흐름을 원래대로 돌려주셨다. 덕분에: The goddess restored the vain flow of time binding Knossos. Thanks to her, everyone trapped there could come outside.
I sensed a strong presence in Knossos and thought it might be you. I was right.
strings.다이달로스, 그동안 크노소스를 지켜 줘서 고맙다. 예전 일들은 네 탓이: Daedalus, thank you for guarding Knossos all this time. What happened before wasn't your fault. Don't dwell on it. Didn't I tell you I'd forgiven the past?
To the place where the Tower of Sages stands.
A magical research institute in Devesis, deep in the continent's west. It was founded after the mage Xerenis died...
strings.제레니스에게 마법을 연구하는 자들이 많이 있는 마을이 있다고 들었는데,: Xerenis told me of a village with many people studying magic. That must be it.
strings.그때 제레니스가 데베시스에서 탈로스를 본 적이 있다고 했는데, 그 말이: Xerenis once said he'd seen Talos in Devesis, but I didn't realize what he meant...
strings.우리 일족이 그 먼 곳까지 갈 일이 없는데, 설마 그곳에서 뭔가 알아낸: Our people had no reason to travel that far. Could he have discovered something there...?
strings.(거기에 바르바토스가 나타난 것과 연관이 있다면….): (If it's connected to Barbatos appearing there...)
Lord Minos, Talos, I need to go. I'd better move quickly.
Understood. We can't keep someone so busy. Go on.
strings.(일단 거긴 어떻게 가야 하지? 아, 일단 네레이스 관문에서 알아볼까?): (How do I get there? Ah, shall I ask at Nereis Gateway first?)
Lord Minos, I should go, too...
What %s is doing now is not our task. We mustn't interfere rashly...
strings.우리는 일단 크노소스를 정비하며 여신께서 부르실 시간을 기다려야 할 것이: We should put Knossos in order and await the goddess's summons.
strings.에담 군, 저번에 제가 멋대로 휴가 낸 일 때문에 복수하는 건 아니겠죠?: Edam, this isn't revenge for the time I took leave without warning, is it?
strings.아닙니다. 편의를 봐주셔서 이번에 제대로 휴가를 다녀올 수 있게 됐는데: Not at all. You accommodated me so I could finally take a proper vacation. Why would I take revenge?
I almost took it as my superior's true feelings: how dare I leave when we're so busy?
strings.이야, 제가 한 방 먹었네요. 그런 말도 할 줄 알고, 에담도 많이 늘었: Well, you got me there. You've certainly improved, Edam, to make a remark like that.
It's all thanks to you, Notos. Oh, %s? Welcome.
strings.제가 오늘부터 며칠 동안 휴가라 자리를 비우게 됐습니다. 그러고 보니 %: I'm taking a few days off starting today. Come to think of it, I can tell you, %s.
strings.동생 내외도 볼 겸 비요르 님을 뵈러 갑니다. 최근에 좋은 일이 있으셨는: I'm going to see Bjor, and visit my younger sibling and their spouse. Something good must have happened lately, because he invited me.
I see. Enjoy your vacation, Edam. Give Bjor my regards.
I will. Please speak with Notos. I'll be off.
strings.%s 님, 안 그래도 연락드리려고 했습니다. 마법청 관련 일이 끝나고 나: %s, I was just about to contact you. There's something that appeared after the Magic Bureau matter ended. A symptom, or a phenomenon...
strings.하여튼 말입니다. 아론 티에네스라는 인물이 사람들 기억을 비롯해 세상에서: Anyway, it seems Aaron Tienes has disappeared from the world without a trace, including from people's memories...
That's right. Only a few people will remember him.
strings.그럼 [위대한 %s의 방]으로 가시죠. 마침 괜찮은 쿠키도 들어온게 있습: Then let's go to the Great %s Room. Some rather good cookies have just arrived.
strings.(모험가와 노토스가 위대한 %s의 방으로 들어가 이야기를 나누고 다시 밖: (The adventurer and Notos enter the Great %s Room, talk, and come back outside.)
From the Empire's perspective, I suppose we should be relieved that a great crisis has passed...
strings.…죄송합니다. %s 님께서 앞으로도 할 일이 많으실 텐데, 너무 제 생각: ...I'm sorry. You still have so much ahead of you, %s. I was thinking only of myself.
strings.%s 님 덕분에 제피로스하고도 화해했고, 아버지가 돌아가신 이유도 알게: Thanks to you, %s, I reconciled with Zephyros, learned why my father died, and even met the spirit...
strings.너무 깊게 생각하지 마세요. 저는 제 일을 했을 뿐이에요. 앞으로 노토스: Don't overthink it. I simply did what I needed to do. From now on, focus on your own work, Notos.
strings.여기서 조금 더 욕심을 부려도 되겠습니까…?: Would it be all right for me to want a little more...?
Haha, thank you. I'll never forget those words.
strings.마음 같아서는 데베시스로 가시는 길에 동행하고 싶지만, 에담 군이 휴가: I'd like to accompany you to Devesis, but with Edam on vacation, there's too much work at the gateway center.
strings.아, 맞다. 현재 현자의 탑이 폐쇄 중이라는 이야기를 들었습니다. 아무래: Oh, right. I heard the Tower of Sages is currently closed. No doubt because of what happened before.
strings.데베시스로 가려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?: How do I get to Devesis?
strings.데베시스는 워낙 험한 곳이라 가는 길이 쉽진 않습니다. 그래도 관문에 있: Devesis is in rugged country, so the journey isn't easy. But the gate here can take you to a nearby hill.
It's a fair distance from the hill to the village, but finding it shouldn't be difficult.
strings.그리고 데베시스에서 도움이 필요하시면 파텔로에게 말씀하세요. 저희 형제에: And if you need help in Devesis, speak to Patello. He's an irreplaceable friend to my brother and me.
strings.혹시 현자의 탑에 계신 마법사인가요?: Is he a mage at the Tower of Sages?
Yes. He's quite well known in Devesis. In some ways, he may be harder to deal with than Zephyros.
Hehe. He's a better person than you might expect.
Thank you for everything, Notos. I'll be going.
You've come all this way. Why not rest a little in the Great %s Room?
No, thank you. I'm in a hurry. I'd better go. See you later.
Of course. I wish you a safe journey.
strings.(모험가가 노토스를 뒤로하고 게이트가 있는 길로 발걸음을 옮기자, 어디선: (As the adventurer leaves Notos and heads toward the gate, the sound of breaking glass comes from somewhere.)
strings.(게이트에 깃들어 있는 마력의 흐름이 흩어지면서 %s의 시야에 낯선 장소: (The magical currents within the gate disperse, and an unfamiliar place opens before %s.)
The hill Notos mentioned, I suppose. Oh, over there...
strings.(언덕 너머 지평선 끝자락에 마법사 모자 같은 것을 쓴 탑의 모습이 보인: (Beyond the hill, at the edge of the horizon, stands a tower topped with something resembling a mage's hat.)
strings.(마을로 가는 길이 어렵지는 않다고 하더니, 탑이 잘 보여서 길을 잃지는: (He said the village wasn't hard to find. With that tower in plain sight, I won't get lost. Let's go...)
strings.(바로 그때 %s의 옆으로 커다란 보석을 든 무언가가 스쳐 지나간다.): (Just then, something carrying an enormous jewel rushes past %s.)
strings.헤에, 여긴 노릇노릇 구운 빵처럼 생긴 프리링도 있네. 게다가 큰 보석도: Huh. Even the Prirings here look like golden-brown bread. And it's carrying a huge jewel.
strings.(놀란 프리링이 다가와 %s의 머리를 보석으로 내리친다.): (The startled Priring approaches and strikes %s on the head with the jewel.)
strings.죄송해요. 링. 제가 놀랐어요. 링. 많이 아파요? 링?: I'm sorry, ring. You startled me, ring. Does it hurt a lot, ring?
strings.아무리 놀랐다고 해도 그렇지, 다짜고짜 보석으로 때리면 어떡해? 아프잖아: Even if I startled you, you can't just hit me with a jewel! That hurts!
Ring...? You can see me, ring? I've finally met someone who can see me, ring!
How could I miss a winged Priring carrying a jewel?
strings.저는 사람들에게 안 보여요. 링. 지나가는 마법사나 여행자 앞에 있어도: People can't see me, ring. Even if I stand in front of passing mages or travelers, they don't notice, ring. They can't hear me, either, ring.
strings.앞을 가로막아도 그냥 지나쳐요. 링. 아, 마르타 눈에는 보이는 것 같아: They walk right past even when I block their way, ring. Oh, Marta seems to see me, ring.
But not as Juriring, ring. I think she just sees a wandering bird, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이라고 말한 프리링이 환하게 웃으며 보석을 들고 있는 작은 날개를: (The Priring who called itself Juriring smiles brightly and waves the little wing holding its jewel.)
I'm Juriring, ring! Tell me your name, ring.
strings.매일 하는 일이 있어요. 링. 그걸 해야 속삭임의 언덕을 지나가는 사람과: There's something I do every day, ring. It makes the people and animals passing through Whispering Hill happy, ring.
If I don't do it, the mirror will eat them, ring.
strings.거울? 얼굴 보는 거울 말하는 거야?: A mirror? The kind you look at your face in?
strings.(갑자기 쥬리링이 놀라더니 서둘러 %s의 뒤로 도망친다.): (Juriring suddenly startles and hurriedly hides behind %s.)
Bad monsters came out of the mirror, ring. I can't attack, ring.
strings.방금 전에 날 때린 건 뭔데?: Then what was it when you hit me just now?
strings.제가요? 링? 놀라서 날갯짓을 한 것뿐인데요. 저기 몬스터들이 오고 있어: Me, ring? I only flapped my wings because I was startled. The monsters are coming, ring!
All right. Let's deal with this first, then talk.
strings.뒤에서 응원할게요. 링!: I'll cheer you on from behind, ring!
They can't come this far, ring. You fought well because I cheered you on, ring.
I did feel stronger than usual...
strings.아까 거울에서 몬스터가 나왔다고 했잖아. 그게 무슨 뜻이야?: You said the monsters came out of a mirror. What does that mean?
There's a mirror that monsters come out of. I don't know where it is, either, ring.
But I'll make the monsters go back inside, ring.
strings.그걸 안 하면 거울에 잡아먹힌다고?: And if you don't, the mirror eats people?
That's right, ring. Some people have been eaten, ring.
I wanted to save them, but they couldn't see me, so I couldn't, ring.
Now I'll do my work, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 눈을 깜빡이며 보석을 든 날개를 하늘을 향해 들고는 살짝 뛰어: (Juriring blinks, lifts its jewel-bearing wing toward the sky, hops a little, and begins shaking the jewel.)
Ring, ring. Be happy, ring. Stay healthy, ring, ring.
strings.링. 링. 엘리 많이 버세요. 링. 영면, 아니, 숙면하세요. 링. 몬스: Ring, ring. Earn lots of Ely, ring. Rest eternally... No, sleep soundly, ring. Run away safely if you meet monsters, ring.
A slip of the tongue, ring.
And finally, everyone in Devesis! Whatever you do, I'm cheering for you, ring!
strings.(쥬리링의 말이 끝나자 보석에서 부드러운 빛이 피어나 하늘로 번진다. 빛: (As Juriring finishes, a gentle light blooms from the jewel and spreads across the sky. It reaches Devesis, leaving warmth in its wake.)
That light makes me feel good.
strings.(역시 보통 프리링이 아닌 것 같아. 일단 쥬리링이 하자는 대로 하고 마: (Definitely no ordinary Priring. Let's go along with Juriring for now, then head to the village.)
strings.저는 착해요. 링. 그래서 응원해 주는 거예요. 링. 저러면 몬스터들 가: I'm good, ring. That's why I cheer for people, ring. Sometimes that makes the monsters disappear or go back into the mirror.
strings.그런데 사람들이 저 빛을 보고 놀라지는 않아?: Don't people get surprised when they see that light?
strings.제가 안 보이는 것처럼 저 빛도 사람들에게 안 보여요. 링. 매일 해도: They can't see the light, just like they can't see me, ring. They don't notice, even though I do it every day, ring.
strings.흠… 쥬리링, 혹시 너 정령 같은 거야?: Hmm... Juriring, are you some kind of spirit?
Juriring is Juriring, ring. Not a spirit, ring.
strings.그래? 알았어. 어, 그런데 저긴 뭐지…?: Really? All right. Oh, what's that over there...?
strings.눈먼 새의 둥지예요. 링. 눈이 보석으로 된 새들이 살아요. 링. 그래서: The Blind Bird's Nest, ring. Birds with jewels for eyes live there, ring. That's why they're called blind, ring.
They used to be magical beasts that tormented people, but not anymore, ring. It's strange, though, ring. Lots of them have been flying to Devesis lately, ring.
strings.배고파요. 링. 힘이 없어요. 링. 이렇게 응원하고 나면 아무것도 못 하: I'm hungry, ring. I have no strength, ring. After cheering like that, I can't do anything but lie down.
strings.음식 먹을 수 있어? 일단 이거라도 먹을래?: Can you eat food? Would you like this for now?
Thank you, ring. Wow, delicious cookies, ring. But it's not enough.
%s, you were going to Devesis, right, ring? Let's go together, ring.
strings.데베시스에 맛있는 음식 만드는 식당 있어요. 링. 저 거기 가서 식사하고: There's a restaurant in Devesis with delicious food, ring. I want to eat there, ring.
I've been to Devesis often, but all I ever did was smell it, ring.
strings.사람에게 안 보여서요. 링. 주문을 할 수 없어서 음식을 먹을 수 없었어: People can't see me, ring. I couldn't order, so I couldn't eat anything, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 제자리에서 도약해 %s의 등에 업힌다.): (Juriring leaps up and lands on %s's back.)
strings.보석 든 손, 아니, 날개에서 힘 좀 빼. 아까 아팠다고. 알았어, 알았: Loosen up that hand... Wing holding the jewel. That hurt earlier! All right, all right. You're not heavy. We can go to Devesis together.
Thank you, ring. Oh, something's a little strange, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 바닥에 내려와 한쪽을 가리킨다.): (Juriring climbs down and points in one direction.)
There's a place on the hill my cheering didn't reach, ring. That's strange, ring.
Where are you going? Juriring, wait... Ah, already gone.
strings.(일단 따라가서 상황을 살펴봐야겠어….): (I'd better follow and see what's happening...)
strings.(언덕 한편의 낡은 풍차 앞, 두 여성이 서로를 마주 보고 있다. 램프를: (In front of an old windmill on the hill, two women face each other. The woman holding a lamp extends her hand, and the cold-looking woman takes it.)
Are you saying you didn't? My choice dragged you along, too.
strings.한때 주인이었던 자 때문에 갇혀서 고통 속에서 시간을 보냈잖아. 왜 두둔: Our former master trapped us in torment for all that time. Why are you defending him?
strings.(얼음 검을 든 여성이 미간을 찌푸리며 램프를 든 여성의 목에 검 끝을: (The woman with the ice sword frowns and points its tip at the lamp-bearing woman's throat.)
I told you not to say that. You know what I'll do...
No matter what you say, I'm going to become a demon.
strings.(램프를 든 여성이 손끝으로 검날을 밀자, 얼음 검이 녹아내리면서 물방울: (The woman with the lamp pushes the blade with a fingertip. The ice sword melts and scatters into droplets.)
strings.잊지 마. 나는 네가 없으면 안 되고, 너 또한 내가 없으면 안 된다는: Don't forget. I can't exist without you, and you can't exist without me.
strings.(얼음 검을 든 여성이 누군가가 다가오는 기척을 느끼고는 램프를 든 여성: (Sensing someone approaching, the woman with the ice sword takes the other woman's hand and hides behind the windmill.)
strings.거울이 안 보여요. 링. 풍차밖에 없어요. 링. 이상하다. 링. 거울이: I don't see a mirror, ring. Only a windmill, ring. That's strange, ring. There should be a mirror, ring.
My feelings are fine, ring. I'll think after I eat, ring.
Then cheer here, and let's go straight to the village.
strings.(쥬리링이 보석을 든 날개를 하늘을 향해 들다가 멈춘다.): (Juriring lifts its jewel-bearing wing toward the sky, then stops.)
Who's here? Even if someone is, you said they can't see you. Just do it.
I get nervous with lots of people around, ring. Stage fright, ring.
strings.(얼음 검을 든 여성이 풍차 뒤에서 나와 모험가를 가리킨다.): (The woman with the ice sword emerges from behind the windmill and points at the adventurer.)
strings.왜 여기서 혼자 떠들고 있어?: Why are you talking to yourself here?
If you're a traveler, keep moving. Don't interfere.
strings.누구신데 화를 내시죠? 방해하지 말라는 건 뭐고요?: Who are you, and why are you angry? Interfere with what?
strings.죄송해요. 기분 나쁘게 할 생각은 아니었어요…. 아무것도 아니에요…. 제: I'm sorry. We didn't mean to upset you... It's nothing... I'll apologize on her behalf.
strings.화냈다가 사과했다가…. 뭐 하는 거예요?: First you snap at me, then you apologize... What's going on?
I'm sorry. We'll be leaving now.
Don't go back on your word.
strings.(얼음 검을 든 여성이 가볍게 미소를 지으며 램프를 든 여성을 뒤따라간다: (The woman with the ice sword smiles faintly and follows the woman with the lamp.)
strings.(쥬리링이 사라지는 사람의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라본다.): (Juriring stares at the departing figure's back.)
strings.저 사람, 대체 뭐 하는 거지? 쥬리링, 왜 그래?: What was that person doing? Juriring, what's wrong?
I've seen lots of people who can't see me, but something was strange... ring.
I was frightened, ring. Scared, ring.
What was scary? She just seemed like an odd villager.
strings.전 데베시스에 있는 사람 얼굴 전부 기억해요. 링. 동물도 기억해요. 링: I remember every face in Devesis, ring. The animals, too, ring.
I've never seen anyone like that, ring.
strings.생각해 보니 %s 말도 맞는 것 같아요. 여행하는 사람이요. 링. 마을: Now that I think about it, you may be right, %s. A traveler, ring. Villagers don't carry weapons like that, ring.
A lamp holding flames of resentment and a sharp ice sword, ring.
strings.무기가 있었어…? 그것도 두 개나?: She had weapons...? Two of them?
I'm hungry, ring. No strength. Let's hurry to Devesis, ring.
strings.(말과는 달리 쥬리링이 힘차게 도약해 %s의 등에 업힌다.): (Despite its words, Juriring leaps energetically onto %s's back.)
strings.…같이 가는 건 좋긴 한데, 꼭 이렇게 가야 해?: ...I'm happy to go together, but do we have to go like this?
I'm hungry, ring. Hurry, ring. Otherwise I can't cheer.
strings.가면서 남아 있는 몬스터 쫓아야 해요. 링. 하암……. 탑이 보이는 길로: We need to chase away the remaining monsters on the way, ring. Yawn... Follow the road toward the tower, ring. Yawn.
Whew... No choice. Let's just go.
You can do it, ring. I'll think about what to eat along the way, ring.
strings.쥬리링? 쥬리링! 다 맡기고 자면 어떻게 해?: Juriring? Juriring! You can't leave everything to me and fall asleep!
strings.안내를 부탁할 셈이었는데 이미 숙면에 빠지다니. 이러면 나 혼자 찾아가는: I was going to ask you to guide me, but you're already fast asleep. I might as well be finding the way alone.
strings.하아, 그냥 두고 갈까?: Sigh. Should I just leave you here?
strings.반짝반짝 보석들, 아름답게 깨지네♬: Twinkle, twinkle, little jewels, shattering so beautifully ♬
strings.(데베시스 마을 입구, 아름답고 긴 금발을 지닌 인물이 벤치에 앉아 이상: (At the entrance to Devesis, a figure with beautiful long blonde hair sits on a bench, humming a strange song.)
strings.이스트랜드에서도, 프레이오스에서도♩: In Eastland and in Freios, too ♩
strings.반짝반짝 보석들, 박살 내러 왔다네 ♪: Twinkle, twinkle, little jewels, I've come to smash you all ♪
strings.후후, 그러면 쓸 만한 사람을 찾아볼까?: Hehe. Shall I find someone useful, then?
strings.(그때 바깥쪽 길에서 마을의 풍경을 둘러보며 걸어오는 낯선 여행자의 모습: (Just then, an unfamiliar traveler approaches from the road outside, looking around at the village scenery.)
strings.여기가 데베시스구나. 저 안쪽에 있는 마법사 모자 쓴 탑이 현자의 탑인가: So this is Devesis. That tower wearing a mage's hat must be the Tower of Sages.
strings.여기저기 돌 반짝거리는 거 보라고? 마력이 좀 들어 있나? 보석은 아닌: You want me to look at all the glittering stones? Do they have magic in them? They don't look like jewels.
strings.생각보다 멋진 곳이네. 어, 배고프다고? 그러고 보니 나도 배고픈 것 같: It's nicer than I expected. Oh, you're hungry? Come to think of it, so am I.
strings.저 사람은 누구와 이야기하는 거지? 어, 뭐야? 킁킁. 귀한 보석 냄새도: Who is that person talking to? Huh, what's this? Sniff, sniff. I smell a precious jewel.
That startled me, ring. Is this person dead, ring? They fell and aren't getting up, ring.
No... I'm too embarrassed to get up. Help me...
strings.이 사람 알아요. 링. 제가 싫어하는 사람이에요. 링. 보석 탐내요. 링: I know this person, ring. I don't like them, ring. They covet jewels, ring.
strings.(모험가가 넘어진 사람을 일으켜 세우며 상태를 살핀다.): (The adventurer helps the fallen person up and checks their condition.)
strings.다친 곳은 없어 보이는데…. 그런데 왜?: You don't seem hurt... But why?
This person's job is smashing jewels, ring.
strings.난 당신 같은 사람을 기다렸거든!: I was waiting for someone like you!
strings.내 이름은 슈비에! 보석 찾아 고향 떠나 프레이오스에 온 반짝반짝 쥬얼☆: My name is Shuvie! I left home in search of jewels and came to Freios. I'm a sparkling Jewel☆Star!
strings.응. 루맨에서. 그런데 루맨을 어떻게 알아? 프레이오스 사람들 루맨에 대: Yes, Lumen. How do you know it? People in Freios never know anything when I mention Lumen.
Oh, well... I know some people there.
Ziskad, Yuran, Ull and Ell, Ren, and the people of the Alliance.
strings.와아, 당신 대체 누구야? 어떻게 그분들을 다 알아?: Wow, who are you? How do you know all those people?
I should have introduced myself. I'm %s...
strings.에? 에? 와아아아! 그 이름 들었어. 여신님 만나서 하늘나라 갔다면서!: Huh? Huh? Woooow! I've heard that name. You met the goddess and went to heaven!
If I'd gone to heaven, I couldn't have come here.
strings.후후. 그런 영웅이 데베시스에 오다니 너무 좋은걸. %s, 내 보증인이: Hehe. How wonderful to have a hero like you in Devesis. %s, will you be my guarantor?
Guarantor? For what? I'm sorry. I have things to do, so I'll have to decline.
Sniff. No choice, then. I'll have to wait for someone else.
strings.그런데 말이야, 혹시 희귀한 보석 같은 거 들고 있어?: By the way, are you carrying a rare jewel or something?
strings.(쥬리링이 들고 있는 보석을 꽉 움켜쥐며 슈비에를 노려본다.): (Juriring tightly grips its jewel and glares at Shuvie.)
strings.그래? 이상하다. 어디서 귀한 보석 냄새가 나서 %s인 줄 알았어. 내가: Really? That's strange. I smelled a precious jewel and thought it was you, %s. I have a good nose for jewels. Maybe I imagined it this time.
strings.아, 배고프구나. 조금만 더 가면 커다란 레스토랑이 있어. 거기서 식사해: Oh, you're hungry. There's a big restaurant a little farther in. Eat there. They have loads of delicious dishes.
We were already heading there, ring. Ugh, I'm hungry, ring.
Hehe. Tell me if you change your mind. I'll be waiting. You're welcome anytime.
See you later, if we get the chance.
strings.신기하네. 여기서 루맨 사정을 아는 사람도 다 만나고. 어, 이건 뭐지?: How strange. Meeting someone here who knows about Lumen. Oh, what's this?
A jewel? Oh, no. It looks like a snake scale...
I only just ate, and I'm hungry again.
strings.(한 남자가 가볍게 기지개를 켜고는 저 멀리 서 있는 탑을 바라본다.): (A man stretches lightly and looks toward the distant tower.)
strings.마법청 문제 때문에 현자의 탑이 폐쇄되는 건 알겠는데, 언제까지 이래야: I understand closing the Tower of Sages because of the Magic Bureau problem, but how long will this last...?
strings.엄청난 소리군. 내 배는 아닌데? 아, 저 사람이군. 어, 뭐야? 저 사: What a sound. That's not my stomach. Ah, that person. Huh? That person...
Just a little farther, ring. That place ahead is the restaurant, ring.
strings.너 그냥 좀 걸어가면 안 돼?: Can't you walk on your own?
Who are you? I'm sensing an incredible amount of magic...
strings.(놀란 쥬리링이 %s의 등에서 황급히 내려온다.): (Startled, Juriring hastily climbs down from %s's back.)
Huh? Was I imagining it? The magic...
strings.(설마 쥬리링 때문인가…? 그럼 어디….): (Could it be Juriring...? Then let's try...)
strings.(모험가가 쥬리링의 머리에 손을 올린다.): (The adventurer places a hand on Juriring's head.)
strings.뭐야, 당신? 엄청난 마력을 숨길 생각이 없는 거야?: What are you? Aren't you even trying to hide all that magic?
strings.그런 게 아니라면서 또 마력이 사라졌네? 대체 뭐 하는 사람이야? 이런: You say that, but the magic disappeared again. What exactly do you do? Magic like that is rare even among mages.
You're a mage, then. I think there's been a misunderstanding... Let me introduce myself first.
strings.(앞에 있는 남성 마법사에게 간단하게 소개를 한다.): (I briefly introduce myself to the male mage before me.)
strings.(소개를 들은 남자가 손을 내밀어 악수를 청한다.): (After hearing the introduction, the man extends his hand for a handshake.)
strings.만나서 반가워. 나는 현자의 탑에서 연구하는 마법사 파텔로야. 편하게 파: Nice to meet you. I'm Patello, a mage researching at the Tower of Sages. Just call me Patello.
strings.당신을 만나면 고맙다는 말을 전하고 싶었는데, 이렇게 마주치게 될 줄은: I wanted to thank you if we ever met. I didn't expect to run into you like this.
strings.고집불통 바람둥이 형제가 당신 덕분에 화해해서 얼마나 다행인지 몰라. 후: I'm so glad those stubborn, womanizing brothers reconciled thanks to you. Whew. They're awful. They wouldn't listen to a word I said.
strings.어느 정도는 알고 있어. 마법청 마법사들이 나쁜 짓을 꾸미고, 그걸로 제: I know some of it. The Magic Bureau's mages were plotting something evil and blackmailing Zephyros...
strings.그래서 다음에 만나면 바유나 협곡 절벽에 매달아 두려고. 제피로스 녀석을: So next time I see him, I'm going to hang him from a cliff in Bayuna Gorge. And while I'm hanging Zephyros there, I might as well hang all those villains, too.
Don't worry. I've done it a few times before. Haha.
I think this person's muscles are stronger than his magic, ring.
strings.아하하…. 안 그래도 노토스 님이 도움이 필요하면 파텔로에게 가 보라고: Ahaha... Notos did tell me to find you if I needed help.
strings.여기서 보니까 탑이 정말 잘 보이네요. 혹시 설명 좀 해 주실 수 있을까: You can really see the tower from here. Could you tell me about it?
strings.내 뒤로 보이는 마법사 모자를 쓴 탑? 저게 바로 데베시스를 상징하는 ': The tower with the mage's hat behind me? That's the Tower of Sages, the symbol of Devesis.
strings.사람들에게는 실바리아 제국 건국 시기 즈음에 공개된 것 같은데, 기록을: It seems to have been revealed to the public around the founding of the Silvaria Empire, but records suggest it existed before then.
strings.저렇게 눈에 띄는 탑이 어떻게 오랫동안 발견되지 않았는지는 지금도 미스터: How such a conspicuous tower went undiscovered for so long is still a mystery.
Long ago, an old man like a sage lived alone in the tower.
strings.언제부턴가 삶의 터전을 잃고 이곳으로 넘어온 사람들이 많아서 이 앞에 자: When people who had lost their homes started coming here, he gave them land in front of it to settle on. That was the beginning of Devesis.
strings.그 노인은 사람들에게 마법을 비롯해 많은 것들을 알려 주고 어디론가 떠났: He taught them magic and many other things, then left. The empty tower became a place for mages.
strings.마법학원 제레니스가 마법사 양성을 목표로 학생들을 가르치고, 마법청은 제: Xerenis Magic Academy teaches students to become mages, and the Magic Bureau aimed to put magic to use for the Empire's people...
strings.현자의 탑은 마법을 더욱 발전시키기 위해 정식으로 허가를 받은 것들을 연: The Tower of Sages is an institute that studies officially approved subjects to advance magic itself.
strings.꾸준히 결과를 내야 해서 어렵기는 하지만… 연구에 소질이 있는 마법사라면: It's difficult because we're expected to produce results steadily... But for mages with a gift for research, it suits them much better.
Hmm. It feels strange being outside the tower this long.
strings.그랬군. 이렇게 만난 것도 인연인데 길에서 이러지 말고 레스토랑에 가서: I see. Since fate brought us together, why don't we go to the restaurant and talk over a meal instead of standing in the road?
strings.(쥬리링 때문에) 많이 먹을 것 같은데 괜찮을까요?: I might eat quite a lot because of Juriring. Would that be all right?
%s, I don't eat as much as I look like I would, ring.
It's fine. I eat a lot.
%s, you'll understand what he means when we get to the restaurant, ring.
strings.(파텔로가 무언가를 느낀 듯 하늘을 올려다보고는, 재빨리 마법서를 펼쳐: (As though sensing something, Patello looks up, swiftly opens his spellbook, and reaches toward the sky.)
A Jewel bird flew over, ring.
strings.(잠시 후, 현자의 탑이 미세하게 흔들리면서 놀라 도망가는 괴조의 소리가: (A moment later, the Tower of Sages trembles slightly, followed by the cry of a frightened bird flying away.)
strings.눈이 보석으로 된 마수가 가끔 둥지를 벗어나 이곳까지 날아오거든. 그래서: Those magical beasts with jewel eyes sometimes leave their nests and fly here. I scare them off.
strings.크게 위협이 안 돼서 예전처럼 토벌하지는 않아. 그래도 페리도트는 좀 위: They're not a major threat, so we don't hunt them down like before. Though Peridot is a little dangerous...
strings.요즘 들어 부쩍 날아오는 횟수가 늘어난 것 같아서. 이건 나중에 마르타: They seem to be coming much more often lately. I'll mention it to Master Marta later.
Oh dear, our guest must be very hungry.
It's fine. Being hungry isn't a crime. Let's go to the Cloud's Threshold.
strings.(단정한 요리사 복장의 여성이 밝은 미소로 레스토랑 안으로 들어오는 일행: (A woman in a neat chef's uniform greets the group entering the restaurant with a bright smile.)
I'll show you to a table. Oh... Patello again...
Ahaha. I've gotten on Chef Raselis's bad side a little.
strings.(라셀리스라고 불린 여성 셰프가 말없이 미소 짓다가 모험가와 눈을 마주친: (The chef called Raselis smiles silently, then meets the adventurer's eyes.)
strings.처음 뵙는 것 같아요. 여행 중이신가요?: I don't believe we've met. Are you traveling?
strings.여행이라기보다는 일이 있어서요. 데베시스에는 처음 와 봤는데, 분위기가: I'm here on business, really. It's my first time in Devesis. It has such a lovely atmosphere.
I don't say this just because it's my hometown. The scenery is beautiful, and there are many good people. Wonderful mages like Marta, too...
strings.파텔로 씨 또 식사하고 가시나요?: Patello, are you eating here again?
...I believe you ate here two hours ago.
I get hungry quickly. Nothing I can do. I came again to bring a guest.
strings.후우…. 손님, 그럼 주문하시겠어요?: Sigh... Would you like to order?
strings.라셀리스 셰프님이 직접 주문받는 거야?: Chef Raselis, you're taking orders yourself?
strings.일 도와주던 친구들의 몸 상태가 안 좋아서요. 며칠만 제가 홀까지 맡기로: My helpers aren't feeling well. I'll be handling the dining room for a few days.
strings.요즘 마을 사람들 사이에서 이상한 꿈 이야기가 많아요. 그 친구들도 같은: People in the village have been talking about a strange dream lately. My helpers had it, too, and have been wasting away, saying their hearts ache.
strings.저번 주에는 저도 그 꿈을 꿔서 쉴 수밖에 없었어요. 그래도 푹 쉬면 괜: I had the dream last week and had to take time off, too. Thankfully, a good rest helps.
strings.언제부턴가 마을 사람들이 모두 같은 꿈을 꾸기 시작했어. 검은 카펫을 밟: At some point, everyone in the village started having the same dream. They walk endlessly along a black carpet, but the atmosphere differs from person to person.
strings.기본적으로 신전 같은 장소지만 어떤 사람은 맑고 깨끗한 하늘을 보고, 어: It's basically a temple-like place. Some see a clear, clean sky, while others see snow-covered ruins.
I dreamed I was walking through snow-covered ruins.
That's why rumors say a demon causes the dream.
Priests came to investigate, but they don't seem to have found anything in particular.
strings.모든 메뉴가 다 맛있지만, 제 추천은 '블러드 슈가 스파이크 스테이크'예: Everything on the menu is delicious, but I recommend the Blood Sugar Spike Steak.
Steak is a common dish, but ours is special.
strings.바로 자극적이지 않은 단맛과 은은하게 매콤한 맛, 거기에 로지언 셰프님의: It's all thanks to our special sauce: a gentle sweetness, a subtle kick of spice, and savory depth perfected by Chef Rogian's skill.
strings.저에게는 개인적으로도 추억이 많은 요리예요. 어릴 적에 부모님의 손을 잡: It's a dish full of memories for me. I used to come here holding my parents' hands and order it as a child. I'd love for you to try it.
One of those, please. Actually, make that two.
strings.라셀리스 셰프님, 나는 메뉴판 이쪽 페이지에 있는 것들 '전부' 주문할게: Chef Raselis, I'll order everything on this page of the menu.
I'll only eat this and won't come back again today.
strings.우와, 맛있어요. 링. 이렇게 맛있는 음식은 처음 먹어 봐요. 링. 배불: Wow, delicious, ring. I've never eaten anything so good, ring. I'm full, ring.
Right? That's why I can never pass by the Cloud's Threshold.
Raselis is acting strange again, ring.
strings.(라셀리스가 주방 통로 쪽에서 넋이 나간 사람처럼 서 있다.): (Raselis stands by the kitchen passage as though in a daze.)
strings.파텔로 씨, 제발 빨리 먹고 돌아가…. 적당히 먹고 돌아가…. 재료 다: Patello, please hurry up and leave... Eat a reasonable amount and go... We're running out of ingredients. I'm sick of it... Nothing lasts with you around...
You jerk. Stop gulping down food I worked so hard on like it's water...
This happens often. She'll be fine.
strings.자, 그럼 본론으로 들어가 볼까? 내가 어떻게 도와주면 돼?: Now, shall we get to the point? How can I help?
strings.그냥 필요한 것만 말해. 내가 할 수 있는 범위 안에서 도와줄게. 나도: Just tell me what you need. I'll help however I can. I don't like complications, either.
strings.데베시스에 전해 내려오는 신과 관련된 전설 같은 게 있나요?: Are there any legends about gods passed down in Devesis?
%s, I'm going to eat this, ring.
strings.마르타 선생님께서 말씀해 주신 건데…. 크리드의 수인이 현자의 탑으로 들: Master Marta told me... A beastkin from Creed entered the Tower of Sages, gained enlightenment, and went to a nearby gorge.
That was at the height of the Sky of Chaos.
strings.정확히는 모르지만, 아마 그 수인이 들어간 곳이 지금 [눈먼 새의 둥지]: I'm not certain, but they say the place that beastkin entered is now called the Blind Bird's Nest.
strings.마르타 선생님께서 예전에 그곳이 위험하다면서 길을 일부 봉인하셨거든. 가: Master Marta sealed part of the route long ago because it was dangerous. You'll need to speak with her if you want to go.
I'll have to meet Marta and hear what she knows.
strings.지금쯤 차 한잔하시면서 쉬고 계실 거야. 식사 다 하고 가자고. 내가 안: She'll probably be relaxing with a cup of tea about now. Let's finish eating first. I'll take you.
Oh? You cleaned your plate. You really must have been hungry.
Thank you for the food, ring. It was delicious, ring.
Oh... It's delicious, apparently. I mean, it was delicious. Ahaha...
strings.다음에 구름의 문턱에 올 일이 있으면 내 이름을 대고 식사해. 사양하지: Next time you come to the Cloud's Threshold, put your meal on my tab. Don't refuse. It's my way of repaying you.
Wonderful, ring. %s, don't refuse. Come again with me, ring.
It's fine, it's fine. Let's go.
strings.와아, 이제 한숨 돌릴 수 있어! 파텔로 씨가 드디어 간다!!: Yay, I can finally breathe! Patello is leaving at last!
strings.라셀리스 셰프님, 목소리가 너무 크지 않아?: Chef Raselis, aren't you saying that a bit loudly?
Oh, am I? I was so happy I couldn't help it...
Patello, please stop coming. But you, dear guest, do visit us again.
Ahaha... Of course, Chef. See you later.
Whew... Now I can catch my breath and eat.
Chef Rogian's food really is delicious...
strings.어, 그런데 여기 있던 빵은 어디 갔지? 또 파텔로 씨가 몰래 집어 먹은: Huh? Where did the bread here go? Did Patello sneak another piece?!
Delicious bread, ring. Following %s gets me tasty food, ring.
So am I. I was wondering where Master Marta was, and there she is.
strings.(커다란 마법사 망토를 착용한 백발의 노년 여성이 신비하게 생긴 구조물을: (An elderly, white-haired woman in a large mage's cloak gazes at a mysterious structure.)
strings.잠시 생각을 정리하고 있는 중이었지요. 안 그래도 신경 쓸 일이 많아서…: I was taking a moment to gather my thoughts. There is much on my mind...
strings.그런데 옆에 계신 분은 처음 뵙는 것 같은데, 손님?: I don't believe I've met the person beside you. A guest?
strings.%s…. 그분이군요. 말씀 많이 들었습니다. 이름만큼이나 눈빛이 특별하군: %s... So you're the one. I've heard a great deal about you. Your eyes are as remarkable as your name.
I'm Marta, the representative of Devesis.
I hoped to meet you someday, but didn't expect it to happen like this...
strings.그대 덕분에 노토스와 제피로스가 화해해서 얼마나 다행인지 몰라요. 네모도: I'm so glad Notos and Zephyros reconciled thanks to you. Nemo would certainly be pleased.
I heard about Nemo when we went to Bayuna Gorge together.
strings.그렇구나. 네모 아저씨도 나와 노토스처럼 마르타 선생님 제자셨거든. 예전: I see. Like Notos and me, Nemo was Master Marta's student. He was at the Tower of Sages once, too.
Nemo was a good person, ring. He threw food to the birds, ring.
I think of him from time to time. He was a truly fine mage.
strings.언젠가 네모의 아이들이 데베시스를 찾는 날이 온다면, 그동안 잘했다고 칭: If Nemo's children ever visit Devesis, I would like to tell them how well they've done.
strings.그대가 데베시스에 온 건 결코 우연이 아닐 것 같은데…. 자, 이야기를: I doubt your arrival in Devesis is a coincidence... Shall we talk?
Master, let's sit on the bench. You too, %s.
strings.(파텔로에게 안내받은 벤치에 앉아 눈먼 새의 둥지에 관해 이야기한다.): (I sit on the bench Patello shows me and ask about the Blind Bird's Nest.)
strings.눈먼 새의 둥지…. 신의 사도로서 그곳에서 확인하고 싶은 게 있나 보군요: The Blind Bird's Nest... As the goddess's apostle, you must have something to investigate there.
strings.평소라면 데베시스 마을의 대표로서 출입을 금하지만… 그대라면 괜찮을 것: Normally, as Devesis's representative, I forbid entry... But I believe you will be all right.
The Blind Bird's Nest is dangerous. I sealed it when I was in my prime.
strings.현재의 전 마력을 제대로 사용할 수 없는 은퇴한 마법사. 길목의 봉인을: Now I'm a retired mage who can barely use magic. I cannot easily undo the seal on the path.
But with Patello's help, it should be possible.
strings.선생님, 바로 가서 할까요?: Master, shall we go do it now?
strings.저, %s…. 혹시 귀한 약초인 맨드레이크를 알고 있나요?: %s... Do you know the rare medicinal herb called mandrake?
strings.그렇다면 행복해 보이는 표정을 짓고 있는 맨드레이크를 구해 주셨으면 합니: Then I would like you to find a mandrake with a happy expression.
Special mandrakes amplify magic, making them very useful.
strings.준비가 된다면 돌아와서 제게 말을 걸어 주세요. 그동안 파텔로 군과 준비: When you're ready, come back and speak with me. Patello and I will finish preparing in the meantime.
I want to see a happy mandrake, ring. I haven't seen one since long ago, ring.
strings.아, 이 새, 오랜만이네요. 제가 젊을 적부터 종종 여기 놀러 오곤 했죠: Oh, this bird. It's been a while. It has visited now and then since I was young. It reminds me of a friend. Hello there...
strings.(마르타 님에게는 쥬리링이 정말 새로 보이나 보네.): (Marta really does see Juriring as a bird.)
%s, I'll stay and play here for a while, ring. See you later, ring.
I brought what you asked for.
strings.맨드레이크가 싱싱하군요. 수고했어요. 이거면 둥지의 봉인을 푸는 데 충분: A fresh mandrake. Well done. This should be enough to undo the seal on the nest.
strings.마침 파텔로 군도 식사를 마치고 올 때가 됐군요. 모두 모이면 이야기하지: Patello should be finishing his meal and coming back now, too. We'll talk when everyone is here.
strings.쥬리링, 그동안 여기서 뭐 하고 있었어?: Juriring, what have you been doing here?
Lying down and looking at the sky, ring.
strings.(아, 마르타 님 눈에는 쥬리링이 새로 보인다고 했지.): (Right. Marta sees Juriring as a bird.)
strings.언제부터였을까요…. 이 새가 가끔씩 날아올 때면 마을에 강한 마력이 요동: When did it begin...? Sometimes when this bird flew here, powerful magic would surge through the village.
strings.혹시 이 새가 그 꿈과 관련되어 있지는 않을까 생각도 해 봤지만, 그건: I wondered whether the bird might be connected to the dreams, but that doesn't seem to be the case...
strings.%s, 혹시 데베시스 사람들이 꾸는 꿈에 대해 알고 있나요?: %s, have you heard about the dreams the people of Devesis are having?
Chef Raselis told me while we were eating.
strings.들으셨군요. 마을 사람들이 모두 같은 꿈을 꾸고 있다는 걸. 네, 사람들: So you heard that everyone is having the same dream. Yes, they are walking through the same place, but at different times.
strings.그곳은 아마도 데베시스의 먼 과거일 겁니다. 그리고 또 다른 시간의 그림: That place is probably Devesis's distant past. And the shadow of another time.
strings.선생님께서는 그걸 어떻게 알고 계시죠?: Master, how do you know that?
strings.25년 전, 마력을 품은 소용돌이가 갑자기 일어나 데베시스와 속삭임의 언: Twenty-five years ago, a vortex filled with magic suddenly appeared and swept over Devesis and Whispering Hill.
strings.일반 생명에게는 알 수 없는 움직임이었지만, 그걸 마법사들은 느낄 수 있: Ordinary beings could not sense it, but mages should have. I thought something terrible was happening.
strings.그러나 그 마력을 느낀 건 저밖에 없었나 봅니다. 마력의 흐름을 따라가: Yet I seem to have been the only one who felt it. I followed the magical current to the Blind Bird's Nest, whose entrance I had sealed.
The moment I stepped inside, a different space unfolded in place of the familiar gorge.
strings.그래요. 그곳은 누군가가 불러온 악마들과 타락한 정령들로 가득 찬 혼돈의: Yes. It was a chaotic realm filled with demons and fallen spirits someone had summoned.
strings.처음은 따뜻한 데베시스의 과거였지만, 한참 동안을 헤맨 제 시야에는 얼어: At first, I saw the warm past of Devesis. But after wandering for a long time, I found myself in a space of frozen time.
strings.겨우 살아남아 끝에 도달했을 때, 저는 얼어 버린 곳에서 보석으로 된 거: Barely surviving, I reached the end and met a spirit gazing into a jeweled mirror in that frozen place.
strings.정령은 절 적으로 여겨 공격해 왔죠. 정령을 쓰러뜨리지 않는 이상 공간을: The spirit saw me as an enemy and attacked. There was no way out unless I defeated it.
strings.어떻게든 있는 힘을 다해 힘겹게 상대하고 있을 때, 갑자기 뒤에 있는 유: As I struggled against it with every ounce of strength, I suddenly felt something like a glass wall breaking behind me...
Thankfully, I seemed to have returned to our world. I could see the gorge containing the Blind Bird's Nest.
And this book was on the ground.
strings.저는 책을 들고 마을로 돌아와 동료들에게 제가 겪은 일을 이야기했지만,: I took it back to the village and told my colleagues what had happened, but no one believed me.
strings.오직 네모만이 절 믿고 도와줬죠. 함께 불길한 마력의 흐름을 찾아 모두: Only Nemo believed and helped me. Together, we found and sealed all the ominous magical currents.
strings.그래서 지금은 그 안에 들어가도, 얼마 지나지 않아 입구로 다시 나오게: That's why anyone who enters now returns to the entrance after a short while.
strings.어쨌든 그 후로는 그 일이 일어나지 않았고, 전 이 책을 해독하기 시작했: In any case, it never happened again, and I began deciphering this book.
You're wondering why I never told you this, Patello.
Afterward, a demon in human form appeared before me.
strings.위대한 벽 사이를 들여다본 사실을 다른 이에게 말하면 데베시스에 있는 모: He threatened to kill everyone in Devesis if I told anyone I'd glimpsed between the great walls...
strings.극심한 공포 속에서 제 기억의 일부가 사라졌고, 그 충격으로 제 마력도: Some of my memories vanished in that overwhelming terror. The shock also caused my magic to fade gradually...
strings.…그리고 얼마 전에야 그 기억을 다시 떠올릴 수 있게 됐어요. 대체 위대: ...Only recently did those memories return. What is this great wall...?
strings.혹시 그 마족의 모습을 기억하시나요?: Do you remember what the demon looked like?
Not clearly. Like a black shadow dressed as a noble...
It's difficult to explain everything... But that demon was destroyed recently...
strings.그런가요…. 어쨌든 이 책을 잊지는 않았다는 거예요. 전 이 책의 내용을: I see... In any case, I never forgot this book. I spent years trying to decipher it.
strings.그 책에 데베시스의 과거에 대한 내용이 좀 있나요?: Does the book say anything about Devesis's past?
strings.어느 신이 사랑했던 땅이라는 것과 그 길이 거울에 있다는 것을 알아냈을: All I learned was that this land was loved by a certain god, and that the path lies in a mirror...
strings.(거울…. 도대체 무슨 의미지? 어, 쥬리링?): (A mirror... What does it mean? Oh, Juriring?)
strings.거울 확인해야 해요. 링!: We need to check the mirror, ring!
strings.마력의 흐름이 이상한 곳은 모두 스물여섯 군데예요. 봉인을 모두 풀고 상: There are twenty-six places where the magic flows strangely. Undo every seal and examine their condition.
If anything seems unusual, make a note and tell me.
Thank you for your help, Marta.
Not at all. I'm only sorry I cannot do more.
strings.선생님 대신 제가 도울 테니 너무 걱정 마세요. 그리고 %s, 내가 준비: I'll help in your place, Master. Don't worry. And %s, I'm not quite ready yet...
All right. I'll prepare as quickly as I can.
I hope you find the answers you seek there. Please take care.
strings.(모두가 자리를 떠난 뒤, 현자의 탑 꼭대기에 앉아 상황을 지켜보던 자가: (After everyone leaves, someone watching from atop the Tower of Sages smiles softly.)
Hehe. Peeking at that time through a gap in the great wall. How interesting.
strings.그럼 더 재미있게 해 볼까?: Shall I make it more interesting?
I'll hasten Devesis's fate as a sacrifice a little. For his sake...
The Blind Bird's Nest is just ahead, ring.
strings.…여기서 보이는 게 마수의 둥지인가 보네. 저기, 뭐가 또 있는 걸까?: ...That must be the magical beasts' nest. What else is in there?
strings.그 거울이란 게 여기 협곡에 있다는 거지? 그리고 그 거울 안에서 몬스터: So that mirror is in this gorge? And monsters keep coming out of it?
That's right, ring. Someone's coming, ring.
strings.안녕, 안녕. 만나서 반가워! 대식가 마법사 아저씨를 기다리고 있지?: Hello, hello! Nice to see you! Waiting for the gluttonous mage?
strings.마을 입구에서 빈둥빈둥 놀고 있었는데, 갑자기 마르타 할머니께서 내 도움: I was lounging around the village entrance when Grandma Marta suddenly asked for my help.
I once helped dismantle a magical device she'd locked.
Apparently intricate spells sometimes require an unconventional sense for magic.
Mages in Freios and Eastland handle magic a little differently, after all.
strings.겸사겸사 나도 들어가서 안쪽 좀 보려고. 전에 내가 보증인 되어 달라고: While I'm at it, I want to look inside, too. Remember when I asked you to be my guarantor?
strings.보석 상인 집안의 보석 광산이 여기 있거든. 적당한 가격에 빌려서 들어가: There's a jewel mine here owned by a family of jewel merchants. I want to rent access at a reasonable price.
strings.그런데 마수가 돌아다니질 않나, 마력 결계 때문에 다시 입구로 돌아오지를: But there are magical beasts wandering around, and the magical barrier keeps sending me back to the entrance.
strings.내 방식대로 여기 결계를 풀려 했는데 시간도 오래 걸리고 위험하대서 그만: I tried undoing the barrier my own way, but stopped when they said it would take too long and be dangerous.
strings.그래서 %s 같은 사람을 보증인으로 세우면 들어갈 수 있을까 했는데!: So I thought I might get in with someone like %s as my guarantor!
strings.일이 풀리려니 이렇게 풀리네. 이건 멋진 모험가님이 데베시스에 온 덕분이: And now everything's working out! All thanks to a wonderful adventurer coming to Devesis. Hehe, you're a lucky charm!
Patello, didn't you say you had preparations to make? You look the same as usual.
There was one part I wasn't sure about, so I ran a simulation in an outside storeroom. It's fine. Nothing to worry about.
I've replenished my magic, too. Everything's perfect.
He ate loads of food by himself, ring.
I want to get into the jewel mine already.
strings.알았어. 보채지 마. 자, %s. 뒤에서 보고 있어. 슈비에는 여기 왼쪽: All right, stop pestering. %s, watch from behind. Shuvie, stand here on the left.
strings.(파텔로가 마법서를 펼치고는 주위를 천천히 걷다가 멈춘다.): (Patello opens his spellbook, walks slowly around, and stops.)
I can feel the magic surging. Does it connect here? All right, open your eyes.
strings.슈비에, 내가 마력 장벽을 흔드는 게 느껴지면 바로 중심을 가격해. 평소: Shuvie, when you feel me shake the magical barrier, strike its center. Just like when you smash jewels.
strings.(그 순간, 날카로운 파열음이 협곡에 울려 퍼진다.): (A sharp shattering sound echoes through the gorge.)
That's one undone. Twenty-five left. Come on, everyone.
strings.신기하군. 멀리서 봤을 땐 그냥 마수들의 서식지 정도로 보였는데…. 독한: How strange. From a distance it looked like an ordinary magical beast habitat... But these oppressive energies make it hard to breathe.
The air feels different from outside.
Hehe, a battle cry. Jewels have to be finished in one hit.
strings.보석 광산은 어디로 가야 하지? 저 위에 반짝거리는 곳이 있는 것 같은데: Which way is the jewel mine? I think I see something glittering up there.
strings.슈비에, 선생님 말씀 들었지?: Shuvie, you heard Master Marta, right?
Yes. Follow you and undo all the seals...
Then follow quietly. You're a Jewel Star who keeps promises.
strings.(쥬리링이 가리킨 곳을 바라본 순간, 앞에서 걸어가고 있는 파텔로와 슈비: (The moment I look where Juriring points, Patello and Shuvie walking ahead begin to fade away.)
strings.파텔로와 슈비에 앞에 거울 있었어요. 링. 두 사람이 안에 들어가 버렸어: There was a mirror in front of Patello and Shuvie, ring. They went inside, ring.
They could be in danger. We need to find them quickly.
strings.둘 다 강해요. 링. 알아서 잘 싸울 거예요. 링. 몬스터들 초전박살이에: They're both strong, ring. They'll fight just fine, ring. One-Hit Smash for the monsters, ring.
Let's work hard to find what we're looking for, ring.
Hmm. Oh, over there... Something seems to be swarming toward us.
strings.맞아요. 링. 괴조 쥬얼들이 잔뜩이에요. 링. 눈에 보석이 박혀 있는 멋: That's right, ring. Lots of Jewel birds, ring. Magnificent friends with jewels in their eyes, ring.
But they don't like anyone entering their territory, ring.
Aaaah! It's not just birds. There are loads of Rock Trolls and Devesis Spiders, too!
No choice. We'll have to defeat them all and get through.
strings.협곡의 길은 다 돌아봤는데, 아무것도 없네…. 그나저나 둘은 괜찮을까?: We've searched every path in the gorge, but there's nothing... Are those two really all right?
strings.둘은 괜찮아요. 링. 둘이 열심히 눈먼 새의 둥지로 오르는 길의 봉인을: They're fine, ring. They're working hard to undo the seals on the path up to the Blind Bird's Nest, ring.
That's how we got this far, ring.
They're wandering around lost, ring. They can't find the last mirror, ring.
strings.또 거울이야? 쥬리링. 넌 그걸 어떻게 알아? 너 대체 정체가 뭐야?: Another mirror? Juriring, how do you know all that? What are you?
%s, hide for a moment, ring. Someone's there, ring.
strings.(누군가가 하늘에 떠 있는 괴조를 향해 손을 뻗는다. 잠시 후, 손끝에서: (Someone reaches toward the monstrous birds in the sky. Sharp icicles form at her fingertips and fly toward them.)
(Several birds are pierced by the icicles and fall from the sky.)
Lauma, summon Peridot now. Otherwise these magical beasts will keep dying.
strings.마수들이 계속 죽어 나가도 괜찮겠어? 뭐, 어차피 마족이나 인간 손에 죽: Are you all right with them dying one after another? Well, perhaps it's better they die by my hand than a demon's or a human's.
strings.우리 약속 잊었어? 그를 다시 만나겠다고, 넌 분명히 그를 살리겠다고 했: Have you forgotten our promise? To see him again? You said you would save him.
Let's meet ▒▒▒▒ again. Only then can you escape me, too.
I'll call Peridot. Stop killing them.
You should have done that from the start.
(Lauma shakes the lamp in her hand, and an enormous black shadow falls across the sky.)
strings.(몸과 눈에 보석이 달려 있는 커다란 새가 하늘을 가르며 내려온다.): (A huge bird with jewels on its body and in its eyes descends through the sky.)
strings.페리도트는 괴조들의 대장이에요. 링. 페리도트는 누가 부른다고 오는 마수: Peridot is the leader of the birds, ring. Peridot doesn't come just because someone calls... ring. Who is that person, ring?
I know you want to live quietly. But act once more, for his sake.
strings.(괴조 페리도트가 그 이름에 반응하듯 눈을 반짝인다.): (Peridot's eyes gleam as though responding to that name.)
Good. Peridot, find the one blessed by the goddess.
strings.(페리도트가 하늘 위로 날아올라 협곡을 살핀다.): (Peridot rises into the sky and surveys the gorge.)
Juriring, let's get out of here.
strings.(하늘에 드리워진 거대한 그림자가 모험가 쪽으로 점점 가까이 다가온다.): (The enormous shadow in the sky draws closer and closer to the adventurer.)
strings.왜 여기에 내려온 거지?: Why did it come down here?
strings.저번에 봤던 여행자가 저기 있어. 뭔가 이상하다고 생각하긴 했는데, 여기: The traveler we saw before is there. I thought something was strange, and now we meet again like this.
Now I see... You're not human...
So what if I'm not? Is that really what concerns you in this situation?
Don't kill them. We need to entertain Belial.
strings.(괴조 페리도트가 경계하고 있는 모험가를 바라보고는, 이 세상에서는 들을: (Peridot stares at the wary adventurer and unleashes a roar mingling terror and emptiness, a sound impossible to hear in this world.)
Hurry, Lauma. Let's find that mirror.
strings.(접전 끝에 %s의 공격이 페리도트에게 마지막으로 남은 왼쪽 눈 보석을: (After a fierce battle, %s's attack destroys the jewel in Peridot's left eye, the last one remaining.)
strings.(고통을 이기지 못한 페리도트가 날갯짓하다가 그대로 바닥에 쓰러진다.): (Unable to bear the pain, Peridot flaps its wings and collapses to the ground.)
I wondered how to fight it, but the jewels were its weakness...
strings.페리도트, 뭐라고요. 링?: Peridot, what did you say, ring?
strings.(쓰러진 페리도트가 쥬리링의 말에 대답이라도 하듯 힘겹게 지저귄다. 이내: (The fallen Peridot chirps weakly as though answering Juriring. Its body slowly cools, and it stops moving.)
strings.(페리도트의 몸이 검게 물들더니 돌처럼 굳는다. 잠시 후, 여러 조각으로: (Peridot's body turns black and hardens like stone. A moment later, it splits into pieces.)
I suppose this was its master's wish, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 페리도트의 잔해 속에서 뭔가를 발견하고는 %s에게 건넨다.): (Juriring finds something among Peridot's remains and hands it to %s.)
There was a mirror inside Peridot, ring. A mirror made of jewels, ring.
strings.아까 페리도트에게 우릴 위협하라고 명령한 사람이 찾던 것 같은데…. 그럼: I think the person who ordered Peridot to attack us was looking for it... So that person wasn't Peridot's master?
strings.왜 이 거울을 찾을까? 아, 그러고 보니 이거, 마르타 님이 이야기해 준: Why are they looking for this mirror? Oh, could this be the mirror Marta told us about?
strings.(그때, 멀리서 거울을 찾으러 사라졌던 자가 다시 나타난다. 놀란 모험가: (Just then, the figure who went to look for the mirror reappears in the distance. Startled, the adventurer nearly drops the mirror, but catches it.)
That person's reflection keeps changing in this mirror...
strings.쥬리링 말대로 거울 속에서 램프를 든 녹색 여자와 얼음 검을 든 여자의: Just as Juriring said, I can see a green woman holding a lamp and a woman with an ice sword in the mirror. I suspected she wasn't human, but those are her true forms...
The mirror we wanted was right nearby, and we wasted all that time searching.
Peridot is dead... It died because of the mirror...
It was a magical beast destined to die anyway. The mirror only let it live a little longer.
strings.너, 정체가 뭐야? 그리고 이 거울은 왜 찾지? 대답해!!: What are you? And why do you want this mirror? Answer me!
I have nothing to say to someone about to die.
strings.길티네, 멈춰. 우리가 여기서 여신의 축복을 받은 자와 싸우면 거울이 깨: Giltine, stop. If we fight the one blessed by the goddess here, the mirror might break...
strings.(그때 모두가 서 있는 땅 아래서 엄청난 진동이 일어난다.): (At that moment, a tremendous tremor shakes the ground beneath everyone.)
strings.둥지가 흔들리고 있어요. 링. 땅이 갈라져요. 링. 커다란 바위가 굴러떨: The nest is shaking, ring. The ground is splitting, ring. Huge rocks are going to fall, ring.
strings.(그 말과 함께 길티네와 라우마, 모험가와 쥬리링 사이의 땅이 거칠게 갈: (As Juriring speaks, the ground between Giltine and Lauma and the adventurer and Juriring begins to split violently.)
strings.(쥬리링이 모험가를 어깨 위로 던져 태운 후, 빠른 속도로 협곡 아래로: (Juriring tosses the adventurer onto its shoulders and races down the gorge.)
strings.으아아아, 머, 멀미 날 것 같아!!: Aaaaaah! I-I'm going to be sick!
strings.(모험가와 쥬리링이 사라진 뒤, 흔들리고 갈라지는 협곡 길목을 바라보던: (After the adventurer and Juriring disappear, Lauma watches the shaking, splitting gorge and sinks to the ground.)
Think of it as Peridot saving us the trouble of finding the mirror.
strings.이 일이 다 끝나면 다시 페리도트를 만들자. 깨진 보석은 내가 챙겨 뒀어: When this is over, we'll make Peridot again. I collected the broken jewels.
Yes, make as many as you like when this is over.
You were like this back then, too. Still talking to yourself so unpleasantly.
strings.(불길한 기운이 뿜어져 나오는 검은 거울 뒤로, 악마의 뿔을 가진 금발: (Behind a black mirror radiating an ominous presence, a blonde woman with demonic horns slowly appears.)
strings.게다가 천한 정령 주제에 내 이름을 함부로 부르고 말이야. 안 그래?: And a lowly spirit dares speak my name so casually. Isn't that right?
strings.(벨리알이 거울 표면을 손끝으로 툭 두드리자, 라우마와 길티네가 머리를: (Belial taps the mirror's surface with a fingertip. Lauma and Giltine clutch their heads and collapse.)
strings.거울 밖으로 잠깐 나왔다고 자유로워진 줄 알았어? 기분 좋지? 응?: Did you think you were free just because you got out of the mirror for a moment? Feels good, doesn't it? Hmm?
You don't even know who let you out of the mirror...
strings.사, 살려 주세요!! 저, 저는 악마가 되, 되고 싶어서………. 크아아악: P-please spare me! I-I just wanted to become a demon... Gaaaaah!
Then you should have asked nicely from the beginning.
strings.미안해. 내가 살짝만 혼내 주려 했는데 그만 힘 조절을 깜빡했네. 얼마: Sorry. I only meant to give you a little scolding, but forgot to hold back. I've been irritated since Jennifer and Alexandra escaped recently.
All I did was put them in and take them out of the mirror a few times.
Oh, does it hurt? Then go inside the mirror and rest.
Scared to go back in? But what can you do?
Get a hold of yourself, ring.
strings.쥬리링, 너 지금 보석으로 내리치려고 했지?: Juriring, were you about to hit me with that jewel?
strings.쥬리링, 너 정체가 뭐야? 쥬리링은 쥬리링이라고 할 거야?: Juriring, what are you? Are you going to say Juriring is Juriring?
strings.맞아요. 링. 쥬리링은 쥬리링이에요. 링. 아앗, 저기 파텔로와 슈비에가: That's right, ring. Juriring is Juriring, ring. Oh, Patello and Shuvie are coming, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 도움을 주고 있는 건 맞는데, 뭔가 이상하단 말이지. 이리스에: (Juriring is definitely helping, but something feels strange. Should I ask Iris...?)
strings.(조용하네. 이번에도 데베시스에 강한 힘을 가진 뭔가가 있는 걸까?): (Nothing. Is there something powerful in Devesis interfering this time, too?)
strings.여기 있었군. 갑자기 협곡 안쪽이 흔들리더니 땅이 갈라져서 놀랐어. 지금: There you are. The inner gorge suddenly shook and split. It startled me. Now it looks fine again?
strings.안쪽에서 보석 광산을 찾아 들어가 보긴 했는데, 희귀 보석 같은 건 하나: I found the jewel mine inside and went in, but there wasn't a single rare jewel. Just loads of ordinary stuff.
strings.그래도 보석 광산 가는 길에 마수가 없어서 다행이긴 해. 나중에 다시 와: At least there weren't any magical beasts on the way. I'll have to come back later.
We're fine. Shuvie's much more skilled than I expected.
strings.고마워, 아저씨! 마력 장벽 말인데, 뭔가 반짝거리는 게 보석 부술 때: Thanks! Those magical barriers sparkle, and breaking them feels like smashing jewels. I like it.
strings.슈비에 덕분에 둥지에 있던 작은 거울이 다 깨졌어요. 링. 초전박살이에요: Thanks to Shuvie, all the little mirrors in the nest broke, ring. One-Hit Smash, ring.
What's this, though? A mirror? I can feel powerful magic coming from it...
strings.우와, 이 거울 너무 예쁘다. 파괴하기 딱 좋게 생겼네. 이것도 부수면: Wow, what a pretty mirror. It looks perfect for smashing. Should I break this, too?
I think this is the mirror Marta mentioned.
strings.우와, 이 거울 너무 예쁘다. 절대 파괴하면 안 될 것처럼 생겼다. 그치: Wow, what a pretty mirror. It looks like something we must never break. Right?
strings.싱겁긴. 그건 그렇고 선생님 말씀대로 스물여섯 곳의 봉인을 모두 풀었는데: Very funny. Anyway, we undid all twenty-six seals as Master said, but found nothing unusual.
Let's return to the village and report to Marta.
All right. Let's go. We need to visit the Cloud's Threshold again, too. Oh, %s.
strings.처음 봤을 때부터 느꼈는데, 지금도 %s 뒤에 일반적이지 않은 거대한 마: I've sensed it since we met. Even now, there's an enormous, unusual mass of magic behind you, %s. It doesn't seem to belong to you, %s...
strings.나도, 나도. 나도 뭔가 느꼈어. 희귀한데 엄청 큰 보석 말이야. 내가: Me too, me too! I sensed something. A rare, enormous jewel. That's why I asked if you had one.
I'm wondering whether leaving the seals undone will be dangerous...
Don't worry, ring. It'll be fine, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 보석을 흔들자 하늘에서 따뜻한 빛이 흘러내려 눈먼 새의 둥지를: (Juriring shakes its jewel. Warm light pours from the sky and spreads toward the Blind Bird's Nest.)
strings.뭐, 괜찮겠지?: Well, it should be fine, right?
strings.어디서 또 희귀한 보석 냄새가 나네. 킁. 킁. 아, 내가 들고 있는 루: I smell a rare jewel again. Sniff, sniff. Oh, is it the ruby I'm holding?
strings.그만 킁킁거려. 자, 그럼 마을로 가자고,: Stop sniffing. Come on, back to the village.
strings.아, 배고파. 나도 구름의 문턱 갈래. 가서 맛있는 거 먹어야지♬: Oh, I'm hungry. I'm going to the Cloud's Threshold, too. Time for something delicious ♬
strings.(파텔로와 슈비에가 앞장서서 걸어간다. 모험가는 뒤에 서서 조금 전에 발: (Patello and Shuvie lead the way. The adventurer lingers behind, looking at the mirror they just found.)
strings.(모험가의 시선이 자신을 뒤쫓아 오는 쥬리링에게로 향한다.): (The adventurer turns to Juriring, who follows behind.)
strings.쥬리링도 마을로 갈 거야?: Are you going to the village, too?
I have to, ring. I'm going to do my work, ring.
Cheering, ring. I have to cheer for the village, ring.
Cheering is cheering, ring. %s, keep standing there and I'll leave you behind, ring.
strings.(확실히 뭔가를 숨기고 있네. 그게 뭔지는 모르겠지만 일단 마르타 님께: (Definitely hiding something. I don't know what, but let's see Marta first.)
strings.(마르타가 마을 한쪽에 있는 신비한 구조물을 바라보다가 흠칫 놀란다.): (Marta looks at the mysterious structure in one corner of the village and suddenly startles.)
The magic dwelling here feels so strong...
strings.(마르타가 다가오는 기운을 견딜 수 없는지 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Unable to endure the approaching presence, Marta sinks to the ground.)
It's all right... It's all right... Hah... Hah...
strings.마르타 님, 여기 계셨군요. 안색이 안 좋아 보이시는데 괜찮으신가요?: Marta, there you are. You look pale. Are you all right?
It's nothing. I'm fine... You've all returned safely.
strings.협곡이 살짝 흔들리는 것 같아 불안했는데 다행이에요. 혹시 특이한 점은: I was worried when the gorge seemed to shake. What a relief. Did you find anything unusual?
Well... Nothing besides the magical barriers you mentioned.
strings.내가 너무 기대했나 봐. 보석 광산이라고 해서 가 봤는데, 완전 코딱지만: I must have expected too much. They called it a jewel mine, but it was tiny. The one near Lumen was decent, at least.
strings.(지스카드 님 광산에 비하면 작긴 하겠네….): (Compared with Ziskad's mine, it would be small...)
strings.그렇군요. 그런데 %s… 손에 있는 건 뭔가요? 반짝거리는 거울…?: I see. But %s... What's in your hand? A glittering mirror...?
Something Peridot was carrying inside its body.
Peridot wasn't among the magical beasts we saw.
strings.F급 오염된 다이아몬드, F급 부서진 루비, E급 쓸모없는 에메랄드, E: Just birds with F-grade tainted diamonds, F-grade broken rubies, E-grade useless emeralds, E-grade dirty sapphires, and D-grade stupid jaspers.
Peridot is their leader. It's dozens of times larger, too.
strings.그걸 쓰러뜨리고 이걸 가져온 거야?: You defeated that and brought this back?
strings.이 거울은 제가 그때 봤던 바로 그 거울입니다. 이걸 괴조 페리도트가 가: This is the very mirror I saw that day. To think Peridot had it...
And this mirror... It seems to be resonating with this structure.
strings.(마르타가 거울을 들고 앞에 있는 구조물 쪽으로 가까이 다가간다.): (Marta carries the mirror closer to the structure in front of her.)
...Oh, you're right. I can see the mirror shaking.
strings.(마르타가 거울을 잠시 %s에게 맡기고 급히 책을 펼쳐 무언가를 확인한다: (Marta hands the mirror to %s for a moment and hurriedly opens her book to check something.)
strings.평생을 해독해도 몇 줄밖에 알 수 없던 내용들이 갑자기 보이기 시작합니다: After a lifetime spent deciphering only a few lines, I can suddenly read the words...
strings.잠시만요. 여기를 조합해서 읽으면…: One moment. If I put these parts together...
strings.「나의 이름을 버리며 모두의 기억을 지우려 한다. 모든 고통의 흔적을 여: "I will abandon my name and erase everyone's memories. Here I bury every trace of suffering."
strings.「그 이름이 다시 불리지 않기를 바라며 마지막으로 이곳에 새긴다.」: "Hoping this name will never be spoken again, I inscribe it here one final time."
strings.(그 이름이 불리는 순간, 보석처럼 반짝이던 거울에 금이 가면서 틈새로: (The moment the name is spoken, the jewel-bright mirror cracks. Through the fissure, a figure previously invisible appears.)
strings.(검은 뿔을 가진 여성이 손에 든 거울이 강하게 요동치더니, 거울 끝에서: (The mirror held by the black-horned woman shakes violently. Black shadows spill from its edges and swallow the entire space in an instant.)
strings.(마르타가 검은 그림자로 가득 찬 데베시스를 바라보며 절규한다.): (Marta cries out as she stares at Devesis, now filled with black shadows.)
strings.(조금 전까지 보이던 것들이 어둠에 잠겨 아무것도 보이지 않는다.): (Everything visible a moment ago sinks into darkness. Nothing can be seen.)
strings.사람들이… 파텔로가… 슈비에가……. 저 어두운 그림자에…. 이건 다 내: The people... Patello... Shuvie... Those dark shadows... It's all my fault...
strings.마르타 님, 정신 차리세요!!: Marta, get a hold of yourself!
strings.(참담한 광경을 견디지 못한 마르타가 그대로 쓰러진다.): (Unable to bear the dreadful sight, Marta collapses.)
strings.(검은 그림자를 밟는 하이힐 소리가 공허하게 울린다.): (The sound of high heels stepping on black shadows echoes hollowly.)
strings.늙은 인간 마법사, 그의 이름을 불러 줘서 고마워. 이걸로 리키모 펠케가: Old human mage, thank you for speaking his name. I'm so happy Likimo Pelke is complete.
strings.하, 그것도 신의 이름이라고 그동안 제대로 말할 수도, 들을 수도 없었다: Ha. So much for a god's name. We couldn't even properly say or hear it all this time. Isn't that funny, %s?
Impatient, aren't you? I was just about to introduce myself.
strings.(벨리알이 한 손에 거울을 든 채로 다른 한 손으로 스커트 끝을 살짝 들: (Holding the mirror in one hand, Belial lifts the edge of her skirt with the other and gracefully bows her head and waist.)
I am Belial. A demon who deceives every emotion in the world and delights in lies.
strings.저 늙은 마법사는 버티다가 쓰러졌는데, 너는 제법 버티네?: That old mage tried to endure it and collapsed. You're holding up rather well.
strings.자랑 같지만, 정말 많은 마계의 마족들이 나를 원해. 내 미모와 힘을 갈: This may sound like boasting, but so many demons in the Demon Realm want me. They come craving my beauty and power. How amusing.
Then they die by my hand, or destroy themselves under the terror of my power.
I heard a human fought Barbatos and survived. It caught my interest.
strings.바르바토스가 널 제대로 만날 날을 고대하는 것 같은데, 그 전에 내가 해: Barbatos seems eager for the day he can truly face you. But before that, there's something I want to try.
As you saw, my mirror, imbued with an ancient god's memories, has swallowed Devesis.
strings.그건 이 아름다운 마을에 존재하는 모든 영혼이 비참한 과거에 갇혔다는 뜻: That means every soul in this beautiful village is trapped in a miserable past.
