And those souls will become nourishment for my mirror.
strings.후후, %s, 나 인간의 영혼을 거울에 잔뜩 넣는 게 오랜만이라 너무 설: Hehe, %s. It's been so long since I put so many human souls into a mirror. I'm thrilled.
strings.어머, 내가 악마라는 걸 그새 잊어버렸어? 그렇게 소리쳐도 소용없어. 여: Oh, did you already forget I'm a demon? Shouting won't help. You need to understand that you can't lay a finger on me here.
Don't tell me... You helped Barbatos...
strings.바보가 아닌 이상 그 정도는 알겠지?: Anyone who isn't a fool could work that out.
strings.좋아. 악마로서 솔직하게 이야기할게. 네 영혼이 탐나. 분명 날 즐겁게: Very well. As a demon, I'll be honest. I want your soul. I'm sure it will entertain me.
strings.자, '리키모 펠케'로 들어와. 특별히 내가 널 상대해줄게. 그러지 않으: Come into Likimo Pelke. I'll face you personally as a special favor. Otherwise, everyone dies.
strings.어리석은 인간, 내가 특별히 자비롭게 초대하는 데도 거부하겠다고?: Foolish human. Would you refuse my gracious invitation?
strings.(벨리알의 미소와 함께 그의 손에 들린 거울이 여러 개로 분열되어 떠오른: (Belial smiles. The mirror in her hand splits into several mirrors and floats into the air.)
strings.(잠시 후, 거울들 속에서 검은 그림자가 강물처럼 흘러나와 모험가의 목과: (Black shadows pour from the mirrors like a river, binding the adventurer's neck, arms, and legs.)
strings.발버둥 칠수록 네 몸을 더 깊이 파고들 거야. 이대로면 넌 누구도 구하지: The more you struggle, the deeper they'll dig into you. At this rate, you'll die trapped in these shadows without saving anyone.
strings.나는 네가 여기서 괴로워하는 것보다는 절망을 느끼며 죽어 가는 모습을 보: I'd rather watch you die in despair than simply suffer here...
strings.작은 확률에 희망을 걸고서 뜻대로 되지 않았을 때 인간들이 보이는 그 표: The expression humans make when they pin their hopes on a tiny chance and it all falls apart... It's so beautiful.
strings.(벨리알이 손짓하자 거울들이 깨지며 날카로운 파편이 모험가를 향해 날아든: (Belial gestures. The mirrors shatter, and sharp fragments fly toward the adventurer.)
strings.이대로 시시하게 죽을 테야?: Will you die such a dull death?
Belial, I won't let you get away with this... I won't...
strings.그 표정, 너무 좋아. 감정을 이기지 못해 일그러지는 모습이란 역시 최고: I love that expression. A face twisted by emotions it can't contain... Nothing compares.
Now, %s. I invite you to Likimo Pelke, where everyone is trapped with no escape.
When you're ready, say his name: Kaulini. Then you'll understand.
I'll be waiting. Don't run away.
Wh-what? What's wrong? You startled me.
strings.파텔로, 슈비에, 수고했어요. 이만 가서 쉬세요. 나중에 두 사람의 도움: Patello, Shuvie, thank you for your work. Go and rest. I'll call again if I need your help.
Oh, %s. There's something I need to discuss. Please stay.
strings.그럼 마르타 할머니. 다음에 또 불러 줘!: Then call me again next time, Grandma Marta!
Understood. Rest well, Master. We'll be going.
strings.(슈비에와 파텔로가 떠나자, 마르타가 조용히 마을 앞의 구조물을 바라본다: (After Shuvie and Patello leave, Marta quietly looks at the structure in front of the village.)
strings.벨리알이라는 악마가 %s에게 한 말은 모두 진실인가요?: Was everything that demon Belial told you true, %s?
strings.미안해요. 내가 그 이름을 입에 올린 탓에…. 평생의 숙제라 믿고 책을: I'm sorry. Because I spoke that name... How can I atone for my foolishness, deciphering the book as though it were my life's duty...?
No. You couldn't have known what would happen.
strings.%s, 악마의 뜻대로 '리키모 펠케' 안으로 들어갈 생각인가요?: %s, do you intend to enter Likimo Pelke as the demon wants?
strings.지금은 그 방법밖에 없는 것 같아요. 여기 오기 전에 그 악마의 능력을: I think that's our only option now. I experienced her ability before coming here.
strings.자세히 말씀드릴 순 없지만, 벨리알은 거울로 가상 공간을 만들어 안에 있: I can't explain in detail, but Belial uses mirrors to create artificial spaces and control everything inside.
strings.지금 데베시스가 벨리알이 가진 거울의 영향을 받고 있다면 그 안으로 들어: If Devesis is now under the influence of her mirror, I'll have to go inside...
strings.(그 순간, 앞에 있는 구조물 끝에서 불길한 보랏빛이 하늘 위로 솟구치며: (At that moment, an ominous violet light shoots from the tip of the structure into the sky, shaking Devesis.)
The demon is mocking us... As though that really is our only choice...
strings.마르타 님, 이 구조물은 언제부터 있었나요?: Marta, how long has this structure been here?
strings.아주 오래전, 마을이 만들어질 때부터 있었습니다. 마을 사람들은 잘 모르: Since the village was founded, long ago. The villagers may not know, but magic has always lingered in it.
strings.마법사들이 오랜 시간 동안 이 구조물이 뭔지 밝혀내려고 했지만, 끝내 알: Mages spent years trying to discover what it was, but never succeeded. Perhaps...
strings.%s, 그 악마가 준비됐다면 그 신의 이름을 불러 보라고 했지요?: %s, the demon told you to speak that god's name when you were ready, didn't she?
%s, stand before it and say the name...
strings.(그 이름이 울리자 구조물에서 옅은 그림자가 흘러나와 바닥 위로 카펫처럼: (As the name rings out, faint shadows flow from the structure and spread across the ground like a carpet.)
strings.마을 사람들이 꾼 꿈속의 검은 카펫이군요. 이대로 쭉 앞으로 걸어가면 리: The black carpet from the villagers' dreams. If I keep walking forward, I'll enter Likimo Pelke.
strings.너무 걱정하지 마세요. 이보다 더한 상황도 겪었으니까요. 어쨌든 제가 가: Don't worry too much. I've faced worse situations. Whatever happens, I have to go.
Marta, wait here. I'll return with good news.
strings.(그렇게 모험가는 악마가 펼친 그림자를 밟고서 데베시스의 꿈같은 기억 속: (The adventurer steps onto the demon's shadows and slowly sinks into Devesis's dreamlike memories.)
strings.(한 걸음 내디딜 때마다 다양한 색의 빛과 그림자가 뒤섞여 데베시스를 가: (With every step, lights and shadows of many colors mingle and fill Devesis.)
strings.(수십 수백 개의 빛과 그림자가 나타날 때마다 시야에 들어오는 데베시스의: (As dozens, then hundreds of lights and shadows appear, the scenery of Devesis keeps changing.)
strings.(더는 주위 풍경이 바뀌지 않을 즈음, 자연스럽게 모험가의 걸음이 멈춘다: (As the scenery finally stops changing, the adventurer's steps naturally come to a halt.)
strings.(따뜻한 빛이 내려앉은 꽃밭, 그 앞으로 작고 아름다운 건물들과 무너진: (A flower garden bathed in warm light, small beautiful buildings, and the remains of a collapsed temple await the adventurer.)
This must be the place in everyone's dreams... It's beautiful...
Mirrors everywhere. Just what I'd expect from a space that demon made. Let's see...
strings.거울 속의 풍경은 눈에 덮여 있네…. 라셀리스 셰프님이 했던 말 그대로야: The scenery inside the mirror is covered in snow... Just as Chef Raselis said...
This feels strange. As though the mirror is calling me...
strings.(모험가가 자신도 모르게 거울을 향해 손을 올리려는 순간, 모험가의 머리: (As the adventurer unconsciously reaches toward the mirror, an enormous shadow falls over their head.)
strings.알았어. 너 안 무거워. 그러니까 그 보석부터 내려놓고 말해. 정신 차렸: All right, you're not heavy. Put the jewel down before we talk. I'm awake!
strings.거울이 깨진 순간, 이곳에 들어와 있었어요. 링. %s, 거울 잘못 만지: The moment the mirror broke, I was in here, ring. %s, touch the wrong mirror and you'll be trapped, ring. I'll show you the way, ring.
I'll find the real mirror, ring.
All right. And another thing... No, let's just go.
strings.왜 더 안 물어요? 링?: Why aren't you asking more, ring?
strings.더 물어봐도 제대로 대답 안 해 줄 거잖아. 누군가가 날 도와주라고 널: You won't give me a proper answer anyway. I'll assume someone sent you to help me.
strings.그보다, 여기서 어떻게 가야 해?: More importantly, which way do we go?
Trust Juriring and follow, ring. %s, look at that mirror, ring.
strings.(한쪽에 있는 커다란 거울 안의 누군가가 커다란 램프를 들어 올린다. 그: (Inside a large mirror to one side, someone lifts an enormous lamp. A woman whose entire body is green appears.)
strings.엘로네라고 해요. 링. 고대신을 도와 생명의 건강과 안녕을 기원하던 정령: Her name is Ellone, ring. A spirit who helped an ancient god and prayed for the health and well-being of living things, ring.
But she betrayed her master, ring. She joined hands with a demon, ring.
strings.그 대가로 소멸할 뻔했지만, 살아 있어요. 링. 대신 저렇게 저주를 받아: She nearly vanished as the price, but survived, ring. Instead, she was cursed and split into two personalities, ring.
strings.(에메랄디아의 주인이던 오즈와 비슷한 것 같은데….): (It sounds a little like Oz, who ruled Emeraldia...)
strings.악마가 정령을 유혹했어요. 링. 정령을 타락시켜서 신도 죽어 가게끔 했어: The demon tempted the spirit, ring. It corrupted her and made the god start dying, too, ring.
strings.(그 말을 들은 거울 안의 여성이 무언가를 붙잡고 흔들기 시작한다. 그러: (Hearing this, the woman inside the mirror grabs something and begins shaking it. The entire space around the adventurer shakes with it.)
She's angry, ring. That's Lauma, ring.
strings.꽃과 나무에게 빛을 전달하는 일을 하는 엘로네의 감정이에요. 링. 타락해: She's Ellone's emotion that brings light to flowers and trees, ring. After falling, she carries fire and burns everything, ring.
I had no choice... It was...
strings.(거울 안 여성의 모습이 다른 사람으로 바뀐다.): (The woman inside the mirror changes into someone else.)
strings.(차가운 인상의 얼음 검을 든 여성이 또 무언가를 붙잡고 흔들기 시작한다: (The cold-looking woman with the ice sword grabs something and shakes it again. Once more, the world trembles violently.)
strings.저건 길티네예요. 링. 구름에서 물방울을 모아 물이 꽃과 나무에게 닿을: That's Giltine, ring. Ellone's emotion that gathers droplets from clouds so water can reach flowers and trees, ring.
After falling, she froze the water into sharp points and stabbed everyone, ring.
strings.시끄러워!! 엘로네는 이제 없어. 죽었다고. 그리고 내가 뭘 하든 네가: Shut up! Ellone is gone. Dead. And what business is it of yours what I do?
Ellone should have vanished for betraying her master, but survived, ring. She's been trapped in the mirror all this time, ring.
strings.(거울에 갇혀 있다가 밖으로 나왔다고? 그렇다면….): (Trapped in the mirror, then let out? In that case...)
strings.보석을 든 프리링, 넌 누구야…?: Priring with the jewel... Who are you?
strings.누구인데 그걸 알고 있지?!: Who are you, and how do you know that?!
strings.…그가 사라지고 이 사실을 아는 이는 아무도 없을 텐데…. 설마 저 프리: ...With him gone, no one should know this... Could that Priring be...?
That's rude, ring! Juriring is Juriring, ring.
strings.그런데 너는 여기 어떻게 있지? 여기는 벨리알이 데려오지 않으면 올 수: But how are you here? No one can come unless Belial brings them.
strings.싫어요. 링. 말하기 싫어요. 링. 겁쟁이처럼 안에만 있으면서 왜 그래요: No, ring. I don't want to, ring. Why are you yelling when you're hiding inside like cowards, ring?
strings.%s, 여기선 그냥 가요. 링. 어차피 벨리알 만나러 가는 길에 엘로네를: %s, let's just go, ring. We'll have to meet Ellone on the way to Belial anyway.
So we can't reach Belial without facing those two.
Giltine, calm down. We have our own task for Kaulini...
strings.(길티네가 조용히 고개를 끄덕이고서 라우마의 손을 잡는다. 그러자 거울: (Giltine quietly nods and takes Lauma's hand. Their figures disappear from the mirror.)
We're short on time, ring. Juriring will guide you, ring. Follow me, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 앞장서자 길 주위에 있는 크고 작은 거울들이 하나둘씩 깨지기: (As Juriring leads the way, the large and small mirrors along the path begin breaking one by one.)
strings.(벨리알이 거울 속에 갇힌 라우마와 길티네를 향해 미소 짓는다.): (Belial smiles at Lauma and Giltine, trapped inside a mirror.)
I thought you'd entertain me a little, like the adventurer.
Lady Belial! Why have you locked us up again? A little longer, and we'd have dealt with the adventurer...
Don't worry. I'll tell him you worked hard to help me.
Stop what? No, she'll give us another chance.
The demon was never on our side...
strings.(라우마가 체념한 듯 길티네를 붙잡고 눈을 감는다.): (Lauma holds Giltine and closes her eyes as though resigned.)
strings.라우마는 똑똑하네. 악마는 누구의 편도 아니야. 그저 너희가 내 말을 믿: Lauma is clever. A demon is on no one's side. You simply believed and obeyed me.
strings.(벨리알이 손끝으로 거울을 두드리자 검은 그림자가 피어올라 안을 가득 채: (Belial taps the mirror with a fingertip. Black shadows rise and fill it.)
I thought I heard a scream...
strings.(벨리알이 앞에 나타난 모험가를 향해 환하게 웃으며, 검은 그림자가 사라: (Belial smiles brightly at the adventurer before her and lightly wipes the mirror, now cleared of black shadows, with her sleeve.)
Welcome. It must have been quite a journey to reach me...
strings.역시 마계의 악마들이 탐내는 영혼의 소유자답네. 불완전하면서 깨끗하고 강: As expected of someone with a soul coveted by the demons of the Demon Realm. Imperfect, yet pure and strong... That's how you made it this far.
An ordinary human would have been trapped in a single little mirror and melted away.
strings.(그 말과 함께 벨리알이 순식간에 %s의 시야에서 사라진다.): (With those words, Belial vanishes from %s's sight in an instant.)
strings.(벨리알이 %s의 어깨를 두드리며 뒤에서 나타난다.): (Belial appears behind %s and taps their shoulder.)
strings.놀라긴. 잠깐 무기를 내려놓을래? 어차피 내가 허락하지 않으면 여기서 넌: So jumpy. Would you put your weapon down? You can't do anything here without my permission anyway.
strings.(역시 그렇군. 벨리알의 주위에 있는 거울들이….): (Just as I thought. Those mirrors around Belial...)
strings.조금 더 이야기를 나누고 싶어서 그래. 어라, 그런데 옆에 보석 든 프리: I just want to talk a little more. Oh? What's that Priring with a jewel beside you?
strings.쥬리링? 방금 전까지는 보이지 않았는데, 어디서 나타났지? 설마 함정이던: Juriring? I couldn't see you a moment ago. Where did you come from? Was it you who avoided the mirror traps...?
That's right, ring. Juriring found the mirrors, ring.
strings.너 뭐야? 바르바토스가 보냈어?: What are you? Did Barbatos send you?
strings.쥬리링이든 쥬얼링이든 관심 없으니까 거울에 들어가 있어!: Juriring, Jeweling, I don't care. Get inside a mirror!
strings.(유리가 갈라지는 소리가 들려왔다가 사라지는 순간, 쥬리링의 모습이 그: (As the sound of cracking glass fades, Juriring vanishes on the spot.)
Aah. I'm inside a mirror, ring. I'll try breaking it, ring. It won't break, ring.
strings.(더는 쥬리링의 목소리가 들려오지 않는다.): (Juriring's voice can no longer be heard.)
strings.너무 겁먹지 마. 네가 겁먹으면 데베시스에 있는 영혼은 누구도 구할 수: Don't be too frightened. If you are, you won't be able to save a single soul in Devesis.
Why don't you quietly hear me out first, adventurer of the goddess?
strings.(그때 깨진 거울의 파편이 어디선가 나타나 %s의 목과 머리, 심장을 비: (Broken mirror shards appear from nowhere, fly toward %s's throat, head, heart, and the rest of their body, then stop.)
strings.리키모 펠케는 데베시스의 과거 모습을 기억해 그대로 재현한 거울 안 세계: Likimo Pelke is a world inside a mirror that remembers and recreates Devesis's past.
strings.고대신끼리 서로 잡아먹을 듯이 싸우던 시간과 비스트가 신들을 잡아먹고 남: It holds both the time when ancient gods fought as though to devour one another, and the ruined age after the Beast consumed the gods.
strings.신들의 이야기, 지겹지? 나도 지겨워. 하지만 어쩔 수 없어. 네가 아끼: Tired of stories about gods? So am I. But it can't be helped. The moment the girl you cherish became a goddess, you were all caught within them.
strings.데베시스의 수많은 영혼이 그 시절의 기억을 공유했어. 이곳을 사랑한 신이: Countless souls in Devesis shared memories of that age. In dreams, they encountered memories cherished by the god who loved this place.
strings.내가 그때 그걸 거울로 봉인했고, 이제야 깨뜨릴 수 있었어. 모든 게 완: I sealed them in a mirror back then, and only now could I break that seal. Everything connected perfectly.
Stop talking in circles and explain. Ugh...
strings.(모험가를 노리고 날아온 날카로운 거울 파편이 얼굴을 스치고 지나간다.): (A sharp mirror shard aimed at the adventurer grazes their face.)
strings.데베시스의 모든 영혼이 그때의 감정으로 붕괴될 거야. 그러면 자연스럽게: Every soul in Devesis will collapse beneath the emotions of that time. Then they will naturally become mine.
With your soul added to the collection...
strings.네 영혼이 탐나는 건 진심이야. 네 영혼을 가지면 바르바토스가 날 제대로: I truly do want your soul. If I possess it, perhaps Barbatos will finally look at me properly.
Back then and now, he's always...
strings.왜 내게 그런 이야기를 하지?: Why are you telling me this?
strings.후후. 바르바토스가 널 아끼는 것 같아서 말이야. 죽이기 전에 미리 알려: Hehe. Barbatos seems fond of you. Isn't it polite to let you know before I kill you? Huh...?
strings.(갑자기 거울이 깨지는 소리가 연달아 들려오고, 모험가를 노리던 날카로운: (Mirrors suddenly shatter one after another. The sharp shards aimed at the adventurer fall to the floor and melt away.)
Ah, what now? Could it be...?
strings.(리키모 펠케 안의 기운이 달라졌어. 혹시….): (The energy inside Likimo Pelke has changed. Could it be...?)
strings.표정을 보니까 날 상대할 수 있을 것이라고 생각하나 보네. 인간 주제에: Judging by your expression, you think you can fight me now. Such arrogance for a human...
strings.(벨리알이 살며시 미소를 지으며 거울에 손가락 끝을 가져다 댄다. 그러자: (Belial smiles softly and touches a mirror with her fingertips. The air inside Likimo Pelke freezes in an instant.)
It was nice to meet you, %s.
strings.(벨리알의 등에 달린 검은 날개가 활짝 펴진다.): (The black wings on Belial's back spread wide.)
Poor little adventurer of the goddess, soon to be devoured by my mirror.
strings.(세상을 조롱하던 악마의 비명이 리키모 펠케 안에 울려 퍼진다. 손의 힘: (The scream of the demon who mocked the world echoes through Likimo Pelke. Her grip loosens, and her mirror starts to fall.)
strings.(놀란 벨리알이 간신히 거울을 붙잡지만, 그대로 균형을 잃고 넘어진다.): (Startled, Belial barely catches it, but loses her balance and falls.)
Hah... Hah... I need to finish this quickly...
strings.(모험가가 틈을 노려 다시 공격하지만, 재빨리 자세를 가다듬은 벨리알의: (The adventurer attacks the opening, but Belial swiftly recovers and blocks with her mirror.)
How long has it been since I fought an evenly matched enemy...? %s, I'm so happy.
strings.(모험가가 벨리알의 힘에 밀려 뒤로 나가떨어진다.): (Belial's power sends the adventurer flying backward.)
Still trying to endure? Don't. Just accept this moment.
strings.(벨리알이 날아올라 모험가를 향해 거울을 내리치려는 순간, 빛나는 무언가: (As Belial flies up and prepares to smash her mirror down at the adventurer, something shining cuts through the air.)
strings.(빛나는 화살이 벨리알의 거울에 박혀 균열을 일으키고, 거울은 그대로 산: (A shining arrow lodges in Belial's mirror, cracking it. The mirror shatters and falls to the ground.)
strings.(벨리알이 바닥으로 떨어지는 거울 조각들을 붙잡으려 하지만, 조각들은 그: (Belial tries to catch the falling mirror fragments, but they turn to dust in her hands and scatter.)
(The adventurer's blow sends Belial flying with a scream of pain.)
strings.짜증 나…. 아끼는 거울이었는데…. 데르족의 화살 따위가…. 여신님께서: How irritating... That was my favorite mirror... A mere Der arrow... It seems our goddess opened the great wall to interfere...
strings.…여신님 뜻대로 되지는 않을 거야. 네가 아끼는 인간이 어떻게 되는지 보: ...It won't go as you wish, goddess. I'll show you what happens to your precious human.
strings.(그 말과 함께 리키모 펠케 안에 숨겨져 있던 것 같은 수많은 거울이 떠: (Countless mirrors, seemingly hidden within Likimo Pelke, float into the air.)
I have all the mirrors I need... Gah...
strings.(순간 벨리알이 얼굴을 일그러뜨리더니 피를 토한다. 떠올랐던 거울들이 그: (Belial's face twists, and she coughs up blood. The floating mirrors melt and flow to the ground.)
strings.(그 틈에서 한 손으로 벨리알의 목을 움켜쥔 자가 불쾌한 기색을 숨기지: (Through them appears someone gripping Belial's throat with one hand, making no effort to hide his displeasure.)
%s, I'll borrow Belial for a moment.
Don't do this, Barbatos. I did it for you...
strings.(바르바토스가 남아 있는 커다란 거울을 향해 벨리알을 내던진다.): (Barbatos hurls Belial into the remaining large mirror.)
strings.(거울이 깨지는 소리와 함께 시야에 보이는 모든 풍경이 어둠에 잠긴다.): (With the sound of shattering glass, every visible scene sinks into darkness.)
Aaaaaah! Help, ring! Oh, I'm alive, ring.
strings.쥬리링, 어떻게 나왔어?: Juriring, how did you get out?
strings.벨리알이 거울 속으로 쿵! 하고 들어왔어요. 링. 그러니까 제가 뿅! 하: Belial went crash into the mirror, ring. So I went pop out of it, ring.
What do we do now? It's not over yet...
strings.(쥬리링이 모험가를 붙잡고 앞으로 밀자 커다란 뭔가가 앞을 가로막는다.): (Juriring grabs the adventurer and pushes them forward. Something enormous blocks the way.)
This mirror is safe, ring. Just watch, ring.
strings.(모험가 앞에 있는 거울이 희미하게 빛나며 둘의 모습을 비춘다.): (The mirror before the adventurer glows faintly, showing the two figures.)
I believe I clearly told you to do nothing.
I only wanted to give you what you wanted. Hehe...
strings.그래서 마계에서 조용히 지내던 날 건드려 폭주하게 만들었나? 글래스턴에: So you disturbed me while I was living quietly in the Demon Realm and drove me berserk? Dropped me in Glaston and made me kill an emperor who had nothing to do with it?
Thanks to that, you learned how Lux intended to use the witch.
strings.벨리알, 넌 날 언제부터 이용했지?: Belial, how long have you been using me?
You were so beautiful, whispering to living beings on Cloud Hill.
strings.그런데 다른 신들이 비스트를 알고 있는 당신을 두려워한 나머지, 모두 힘: But the other gods feared you because you knew the Beast. They joined forces and turned you into a human.
strings.그들은 인간이 된 당신조차 두려웠는지 결국 죽이려 했어. 그때 당신이 사: Even as a human, they feared you enough to try to kill you. Remember how all the lives you loved died then?
The age of Cloud Hill you knew disappeared.
strings.그래서 내가 가만히 있을 수 없어서 당신을 도왔어. 언젠가 당신이 볼 수: So I couldn't stand by. I helped you. I made those memories into Likimo Pelke so you could see them someday. What do you think?
strings.그 도움으로 악마의 꾀에 넘어간 자는 신을 죽이고, 그 벌로 마계에 떨어: With that help, the one deceived by a demon killed a god. As punishment, he fell into the Demon Realm and lost his memories...
strings.날 위해 싸우던 정령조차 지키지 못했고, 정령은 악마의 꾀에 무너져 타락: He couldn't even protect the spirit who fought for him. She succumbed to the demon's trickery and fell...
strings.마계에 떨어진 당신에게는 '절망'이라는 단어가 참 잘 어울렸어. 당신도: 'Despair' suited you so well after you fell into the Demon Realm. You liked it too, didn't you? Barbatos, Grand Duke of Despair!
Hehe. Everything was so perfect that I waited. For the day you would rise again...
Ahaha... So you waited thousands of years...? Mad demon...
strings.지금 이 세상에서 당신을 알고 있는 존재 중에서 내가 제일 오래됐어. 유: Of all the beings in this world who know you, I've known you the longest. Your only love. Yes, I will be your last.
strings.크큭. 웃기는군. 악마의 입에서 어울리지도 않는 말이 나오다니…. 이거야: Heh. Ridiculous. Such unsuitable words from a demon's mouth... Now that is deception.
You don't love me. You want the power I had as a god.
To me, they're the same, Barbatos. I meant to wait a little longer...
strings.아, 지금은 내가 좀 안 내키네. 바르바토스, 아니, 카울리니. 잊지 마: Ah, I'm not in the mood now. Barbatos... No, Kaulini. Don't forget. I will be beside you at your final moment.
strings.그리고 당신이 사랑한 이 세계를 거울 속에 가둔 채로 더럽히겠어. 저 모: And I will trap this world you loved inside a mirror and defile it. Along with that adventurer.
Hehe. Of all places, you brought me inside a mirror...
You leave me no choice but to become Kaulini again. Ellone, too... Yes, I...
strings.(사방에서 거울과 날카로운 조각들이 연달아 깨지는 소리가 울려 퍼진다.): (The sounds of mirrors and sharp fragments shattering echo from every direction.)
strings.우리 빨리 나가야 해요! 링! 리키모 펠케가 무너지고 있어요. 링!: We need to leave now, ring! Likimo Pelke is collapsing, ring!
But we haven't defeated Belial yet...
strings.여신님 화살이 벨리알의 나쁜 거울 깨뜨려서 괜찮아요. 링. 악마의 힘 없: The goddess's arrow broke Belial's evil mirror, so it's all right, ring. The demonic power is gone, ring. Let's survive first, ring.
strings.(모험가가 쥬리링의 발밑에서 반짝거리는 뭔가를 발견한다.): (The adventurer notices something shining at Juriring's feet.)
strings.%s, 이거 챙겨요. 링. 구름의 언덕이 보이는 거울이에요. 링. 이게: %s, take this, ring. A mirror showing Cloud Hill, ring. We need it to get out, ring.
strings.이 거울이 있어야 한다고? 또 거울이야? 으아아아, 뭐야, 쥬리링?: We need this mirror? Another mirror? Aaaah, what are you doing, Juriring?
strings.(쥬리링이 모험가를 붙잡아 어깨 위로 던진다.): (Juriring grabs the adventurer and tosses them onto its shoulders.)
I have to save you, ring. That's what Juriring must do, ring.
All right, Juriring. Let's return to Devesis.
strings.(쥬리링이 모험가를 업은 채 깨진 거울 틈을 향해 높이 뛰어올라, 접혀: (Carrying the adventurer, Juriring leaps high toward a gap in a broken mirror, spreads its folded wings wide, and begins flying powerfully.)
strings.(마르타가 앞에 서 있는 구조물을 바라보다가 놀라 뒤로 물러난다.): (Marta watches the structure before her, then steps back in surprise.)
strings.(보이지 않는 장벽이 무너지고 있어…. 불길한 기운도 모두 사라지고 있고: (The invisible barrier is collapsing... The ominous presence is disappearing, too...)
strings.(그때 허공에서 커다란 그림자가 나타나더니 그대로 바닥에 떨어진다.): (An enormous shadow appears in the air and drops straight to the ground.)
%s, wake up, ring. I'm not hitting your head, so stop holding it, ring. We're back, ring.
Marta. I'm fine. I'm back safely.
strings.데베시스를 감싸고 있던 나쁜 기운이 사라졌던데…. 그리고 이 책, 더는: The evil presence surrounding Devesis has vanished... And I can no longer read this book... That must have been the end.
strings.다행이에요. 링. 그래야 맞아요. 링. 아, %s, 마르타에게 거울 주세: I'm glad, ring. That's how it should be, ring. Oh, %s, give Marta the mirror, ring.
strings.(마르타가 %s에게서 거울을 받아 들고는 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Marta takes the mirror from %s and falls speechless.)
strings.마르타, 괜찮아요, 링?: Marta, are you all right, ring?
strings.어, 저 보여요, 링?!: Oh, you can see me, ring?!
strings.보이다마다…. 우리 꼭 다시 만나자 그랬는데…. 왜 이제야 나타난 거니?: Of course I can... We promised to meet again... Why did you only appear now?
I was always in Devesis, ring. I came often because I missed you, Marta, ring.
So that bird that kept appearing was you...
strings.(마르타가 손을 내밀자 쥬리링이 다가와 몸을 비비며 기뻐한다.): (Marta extends her hand. Juriring approaches and happily rubs against her.)
It was a Priring only I could see, ever since I came here...
strings.그 세계의 유리 벽이 깨지고 이 책을 손에 넣은 후로 만날 수 없었습니다: After the glass wall of that world broke and I obtained this book, I couldn't see it anymore.
Juriring, it seems there's something I must do with this mirror.
That's right, Marta, ring. I have a favor to ask, ring.
strings.이 거울 속의 기억을 %s에게 주세요. 링. 그래야 여신님에게 도움이 돼: Give the memories in this mirror to %s, ring. That will help the goddess. Devesis won't be in danger anymore, ring.
strings.쥬리링은 그때도 믿어 달라 했죠. 믿었기에 데베시스를 지킬 수 있었습니다: Juriring asked me to trust it back then, too. Because I did, I was able to protect Devesis.
strings.쥬리링, 너도 알다시피 내게는 남은 마력이 없단다. 기억을 주는 방법은: Juriring, as you know, I have no magic left. Sharing memories won't be easy...
It's all right, ring. I'll help, ring.
strings.그래, 알았다. 어떻게 하면 되지?: All right. What should we do?
strings.설마 보석으로 내 머리를 내리치려는 건 아니지?: You're not going to hit my head with the jewel, are you?
Oh, a good idea, ring. But no, ring.
strings.기억을 나눌 마르타와 %s, 두 사람이 거울을 붙잡아요. 링. 그럼 나머: Marta and %s, the two who will share the memories, hold the mirror, ring. I'll handle the rest, ring.
strings.(쥬리링의 말을 따라 마르타와 모험가가 거울의 양쪽 끝을 붙잡는다. 그러: (Following Juriring's instructions, Marta and the adventurer hold opposite ends of the mirror. Juriring lifts its jewel and strikes the mirror.)
strings.(거울이 충격으로 조각나고, 조각은 곧 가루가 되어 흩어진다. 흩어진 가: (The impact shatters the mirror. Its fragments turn to powder, scatter on the wind around the Tower of Sages, and vanish without a trace.)
strings.(그 순간 %s의 머릿속으로 어느 때보다 선명한 누군가의 기억이 들어온다: (At that moment, someone's memories enter %s's mind with unprecedented clarity.)
Finished, ring. %s, come back to your senses, ring.
I'm not holding anything over your head, %s, ring.
Is it all right for me to remember this? These are someone else's memories...
The goddess needs to know, ring.
The memories of those who loved this place strengthened Devesis's magical barrier, ring. Evil demons can no longer come here, ring.
strings.(마르타가 환하게 웃는 쥬리링의 머리를 살며시 쓰다듬는다.): (Marta gently strokes the head of the brightly smiling Juriring.)
strings.(그 말과 함께 쥬리링이 두 사람을 빤히 바라본다.): (Juriring gazes steadily at the two of them.)
Goodbye, ring. You two won't be able to see Juriring anymore, ring.
Juriring is a Priring only those protecting Devesis can see, ring.
Once that's over, you can't see me anymore, ring.
strings.이 세계에 올 때부터 그래서 자세한 이유는 몰라요. 링. 몰라서 대답 못: It's been that way since I came into this world, so I don't know the details, ring. That's why I couldn't answer, ring.
Juriring... So that's why you disappeared back then...
strings.쥬리링은 사라지지 않아요. 링. 데베시스에 있어요. 링. 앞으로도 데베시: Juriring isn't disappearing, ring. I'll be in Devesis, ring. I'll keep cheering for Devesis, ring.
strings.(그렇게 쥬리링의 모습이 사라지는 그때, 어디선가 본 듯한 따뜻한 빛의: (As Juriring disappears, a familiar-looking sphere of warm light descends before %s.)
strings.(쥬리링이 풀밭에 엎드려 하늘을 바라보고 있다.): (Juriring lies in the grass, looking at the sky.)
strings.사람들에게 안 보이는 거 너무 슬퍼요. 링. 날 볼 수 있는 사람 그렇게: It's so sad that people can't see me, ring. I waited so long for someone who could...
strings.(그때 쥬리링의 시야에 %s의 얼굴이 들어온다.): (Just then, %s's face comes into Juriring's view.)
You can't see me even if you call, ring.
Keep calling all you want. Even if I answer, you won't see or hear me, ring.
I'd better stop looking for Juriring. Shall I take a break?
strings.(모험가가 자리를 잡고 준비한 음식을 꺼내 펼친다.): (The adventurer settles down and spreads out the food they prepared.)
Too many sandwiches and snacks to eat alone...
I think I need someone to share them with.
Should I pretend to be a ghost and steal some, ring?
Don't do that. Come eat. There's some for you.
Don't panic. Careful with the jewel.
I can see you clearly. And touch you, too.
strings.(쥬리링이 보석으로 얼굴을 가리고 근처 바위 뒤로 가서 숨는다. 하지만: (Juriring covers its face with the jewel and hides behind a nearby rock. But its body is so big that a wing sticks out.)
I'm embarrassed, ring. Now I'm just a Priring who gave a dramatic goodbye, ring.
strings.이리스가 도와줘서 고맙다면서 쥬리링 소원 들어준대. 일단 나와 마르타 님: Iris says thank you for helping, and she'll grant your wish. You don't need to hide from Marta or me anymore.
strings.(모험가가 쥬리링을 잡아당겨 그 앞에 샌드위치 하나를 놓는다.): (The adventurer pulls Juriring over and places a sandwich in front of it.)
strings.이거 먹고 저 뭐 해요? 링?: What do I do after eating this, ring?
You don't have to do anything. I asked Iris about you.
strings.여신님이 뭐라고 해요? 링?: What did the goddess say, ring?
strings.그냥 놀고먹기 좋아하는 프리링이 데베시스에 있던 마력에 영향을 받았고,: An ordinary Priring that liked eating and playing was affected by the magic in Devesis, and came to live a very long time.
Over time, you became something like a Spirit King.
See, ring? Juriring is Juriring, ring. Juriring who used to be a Priring, ring.
strings.처음엔 작은 프리링이었어?: Were you a little Priring at first?
strings.작고 귀여웠어요. 링. 지금은 크지만 귀여워요. 링. 그때 보석 선물 받: Little and cute, ring. Now I'm big and cute, ring. I got a jewel as a gift and played with the birds, and became like this, ring.
strings.보석 선물? 누가 줬는데?: A jewel as a gift? Who gave it to you?
A strange-looking person, ring. Looked like that person passing over there, ring.
strings.얼마나 이상하게 생겼는데? 어, 잠깐. 저기 지나가는 사람?: How strange-looking? Wait. Someone passing over there?
strings.(모험가가 쥬리링의 말에 놀라 언덕 아래를 바라본다. 그러자 밑에 있는: (Startled by Juriring's words, the adventurer looks down the hill. A boy below meets their eyes, apparently recognizing them.)
strings.(모험가가 서둘러 언덕 아래로 뛰어 내려가지만, 소년의 모습은 온데간데없: (The adventurer hurries down the hill, but the boy is nowhere to be found.)
It was that person, ring. But where did he go, ring? There's nowhere to go from here, ring.
Oh, yes, Goddess. Yes, understood, ring.
strings.어? 누구하고 이야기하고 있어? 이리스?: Huh? Who are you talking to? Iris?
strings.이리스 님이에요. 링. 때가 되면 카울리니…였던 바르바토스에 대해 %s에: It's Iris, ring. When the time comes, I'll tell %s about Barbatos... who used to be Kaulini, ring.
strings.어차피 쥬리링은 쥬리링이에요, 라고 할 거잖아. 원래부터 쥬리링이었으니까: You'd just say 'Juriring is Juriring' anyway. You've been Juriring from the start, after all...
That's right. Juriring is Juriring, ring.
strings.(쥬리링이 모험가 옆으로 다가와 몸을 비빈다.): (Juriring approaches and rubs against the adventurer.)
I want to go to the village, ring. Let's see Marta, ring.
strings.(분명 그 사람, 어디선가 본 듯한 느낌이 들었는데…. 누구지? 전혀 기: (I'm sure I've seen that person somewhere before... Who was he? I can't remember at all... I'll have to ask Iris later...)
strings.(이리스가 이제 데베시스는 괜찮다고 했으니 다행이긴 한데….): (At least Iris said Devesis is safe now...)
